products.title: Tarang Bar Gift Set - Glass & Decanter - Set of 3
products.body_html:
• Tarang, for a wave, inspires the fine vertical flutes cut into the height of each piece.
  • A decanter and two whisky glasses, all with a blush tint settling at the base.
  • The flutes catch and throw light down the sides as each glass is lifted.
  • Dimensions: Whiskey Glass - 8.5 x 8.5 x 8 Cm, Decanter - 8.5 x 8.5 x 18 Cm

products.title: Khasi Mug - Set of 2
products.body_html:
• A treat for the eyes: this pretty mug features soft-pink blossoms against a bold monochrome stripes
  • Crafted in porcelain
  • Imported

products.title: Poppy Mug - Set of 2
products.body_html:
• Inspired by the wilderness of the Himalayas, this Poppy Mug is the prettiest addition to your mugs collection
  • Imported
  • Capacity (each): 225 ml

products.title: Wildflower Mug - Set of 2
products.body_html:
• This mug has our heart with its fresh, pastel blue base and bold floral designs, inspired by the wilderness of the Himalayas
  • Crafted in porcelain
  • Ideal for coffee and tea time
  • Imported

products.title: Solenne Gift Set - TSSxNB
products.body_html:
• Two quarter plates and four espresso mugs, all in stoneware.
  • The palette is multi and copper, so the pieces sit together without needing to match exactly.
  • Made for serving coffee with something small on the side.
  • Dimensions: - Quarter Plate- 19 x 19 x 5cm, Espresso Mug- 8 x8 x 7 cm

products.title: Aurelia Gift Set - TSSxNB
products.body_html:
• A stoneware cookie tray with tongs, four brass stirrers and four whiskey glasses, gathered into one set.
  • The tray and the stirrers are of gold-toned brass.
  • For the host who serves something sweet alongside the pour.
  • Dimensions: - Cookie Tray- 30x14x2 Cm,Stirrer- 16 Cm,Glass- 9x9 Cm, Tong- 12x4 Cm

products.title: Celeste Gift Set - TSSxNB
products.body_html:
• A stoneware cookie tray with tongs, a pair of nut bowls with spoons, a kebab pick and four whiskey glasses.
  • The tray and bowls are stoneware in multi and copper tones, and the pick is stainless steel and aluminium.
  • Built for a bar tray with snacks to share.
  • Dimensions: - Cookie Tray- 30 x 14 x 2 cm,Kebab Pick-8.5 x 12.5 cm, Glass- 9.40 cm, Nut Bowl- 10 x 10 x 7 cm, Spoon- 11x2.7 Cm, Tong- 12x4 Cm

products.title: WIlderness Mug Set
products.body_html:
• The Wilderness Mug Set is a heady dose of the wild featuring a set of 2 Lemur Mugs and set of 2 Lotus Garden Mugs.
  • A set of two stoneware mugs with motifs, the Lemur Mugs are inspired by the indigenous flora and fauna of Madagascar.
  • The perfect accompaniment to your everyday rituals, the Lotus Garden Mugs are generously proportioned and designed for bottomless cups of tea/coffee.

products.title: The Cirrus Shirt Set - Ink Blue
products.body_html:
• A set of two of our signature styles, the Cirrus Shirt and the Yoka Trousers in ink blue.
  • A modern classic: you'll take this boxy shirt from daily to downtime. Made in cotton poplin, its ink blue hue makes this an easy pick to spend your day in.
  • Crafted in linen cotton, this style features a tight waist and generous pockets and pairs well with tunics and kurtas or one of our many billowy tops.
  • Clean, light, and detailed up close, this set balances contrast and summer ease.

products.title: Sahara Dinner Set (Set of 2)
products.body_html:
• A set of 2 Sahara dinner plates, 2 Sahara katoris, and 2 Asfar quarter plates — a four-cover setting in our signature stoneware, drawing on Morocco's cobalt blue pottery, Zellij tilework, and bright lemons.
  • The dinner plates carry the full still life of lemons and blue vases, the katoris pick up the Zellij pattern from Fez, and the Asfar quarter plates bring the palette in a simpler frame.
  • Built for hosting that wants colour on the table. Pair with white linens to let the cobalt and yellow do the work, and finish with fresh lemons at the centre.

products.title: The Lehar Set
products.body_html:
• NicoBaraat has arrived! Timeless pieces reimagined for the people who make weddings the joyful chaos that they are. This set is the one you'll be dancing in for years to come.
  • This set includes the Bindu Skirt in a red and ivory print, the Inaaz Blouse in red embroidery, and the red and ivory printed Lehar Dupatta. A perfect look for being part of the baraat.
  • The Bindu Skirt is a playful red and ivory piece in cotton silk chanderi, featuring heavy yet playful tassels at the dori ends, and a pop of gold gota detailing. The big statement polka dots are inspired by the universal bindu.
  • The Inaaz Blouse is a vibrant red piece in 100% organic cotton voile, featuring all-over floral embroidery in gold and silver zari with a pop of green, for a delicate and textured finish.
  • The Lehar Dupatta is a red and ivory piece in muga silk, featuring red chintz on an ivory base, gota detailing on all sides, a heart motif, and finished with tassels at the corners.

products.title: Ceylon Garden Cereal Bowl Set
products.body_html:
• Make the first meal of the day a joyful affair with the Botanical Breakfast Set that comes with the Botanical Cereal Bowl (Set of 2) and Ceylon Cereal Bowl (Set of 2).
  • Bowl food = soul food. Start your day on the right foot and with a little flourish. These bowls are the perfect quantity for your everyday cereal and milk or any other breakfast preparation.
  • A quaint addition to tables, the Giraffe Menu Card Holder features a majestic, golden motif of the animal for your tables.

products.title: Guldasta Dupatta - Printed Silk
products.body_html:
• NicoBaraat has arrived! Timeless pieces reimagined for the people who make weddings the joyful chaos that they are.
  • The Guldasta Dupatta puts a bouquet on the shoulder: a bold print of flowers across purple silk.
  • 100% silk in purple, with the Guldasta print in digital print all over.
  • Hand embroidery lifts the print, so the flowers carry thread and colour.
  • The borders are faced in purple cotton silk with the dual tone star foil print, the same stars as the Sagan Sharara.
  • Gota lace runs along all four sides, with tassels at two opposite corners.

products.title: Baraati Kurti - Embroidered Mukaish Cotton Silk
products.body_html:
• NicoBaraat has arrived! Timeless pieces reimagined for the people who make weddings the joyful chaos that they are.
  • The Baraati Kurti is named for the guests who arrive dancing in the groom's procession, and it is dressed for the part in chartreuse.
  • Cut in cotton silk in chartreuse, this is a short kurti in a regular fit, with full sleeves.
  • Mukaish covers the surface from neckline to hem, embroidered by hand in aqua blue and rose gold. It is the Lucknow technique of setting metal wire into small points of light, and worked all over, it glints with every step.
  • Triangle gota lace runs along the sleeve hems, the side slit and the hemline, with chartreuse facings and neck piping in the same colour as the body.
  • Inside, a berry moon patch is piped in black and white tiny checks, a small contrast for the wearer to find.

products.title: Garden Essence Set
products.body_html:
• Strike a match and find stillness with the Garden Essence Set, where the Anar Incense Set (Anglesey) meets Kamal Incense Holders (Set of 2).
  • The Anar Incense Set features a set of two: incense holder and 12 incense sticks which fill the air with a juicy tang of blackcurrant.
  • Crafted in sturdy brass, the Kamal Incense holders feature a beautiful lotus design that add a touch of festive to your nooks

products.title: Peru Jumpsuit - Cotton Denim Relaxed Fit
products.body_html:
• The Peru Jumpsuit in blue is the one-piece that does everything. A statement jumpsuit for the woman who wants one piece that rises to every occasion.
  • Crafted in 100% cotton denim in a dark blue wash, the fabric is soft, durable, and breathable, carrying the characteristic quality of getting better with every wear as the fibres soften and develop character.
  • Red stitching accents run across the garment, turning every seam into a graphic design moment that gives the jumpsuit a bold, handcrafted edge.
  • A collage of stamps at the back, slit sleeves at the front, and embellishments at the front lower leg create a layered design story that reveals itself from every angle.
  • Pair it with sneakers for a casual day out, sandals for a summer afternoon, or layer a jacket over for a modern, considered evening look.

products.title: The Imke Kurta Set - Multicolour
products.body_html:
• The Imke Kurta Set brings together the Imke Kurta and Classic Pyjamas in multicolour prints designed for playful comfort.
  • Inspired by Kashmiri kani shawls, the kurta’s heart and bird motifs are woven into running stripes, finished with a moon patch in diagonal stripes.
  • The pyjamas echo the same kani inspired stripe rhythm in airy organic cotton voile with an elasticated back waistband.
  • Together, the set is light, joyful, and full of movement in print and colour.

products.title: The Gusset Long Kurta Set - Green
products.body_html:
• Crafted for both quiet mornings and lively evenings, this set brings together soft florals and a relaxed silhouette for a look that’s thoughtful yet dressy.
  • The Gusset Long Kurta makes a statement with its efforltess fall and deep green hue, perfect for celebrations. Made in 100% cotton kora, offering a breathable, natural feel with a subtle texture that adds depth to the garment.
  • Comfort meets style with our classic Paperbag Waist Pants. These pants come in a vibrant bright green that adds energy to any outfit. Crafted from cotton linter, a natural byproduct of cottonseed oil production, Bemberg is a regenerated cellulose fibre that’s soft, breathable, and gentle on the skin. It’s biodegradable, compostable, and made using a closed-loop process that minimises waste, making it a thoughtful choice for you and the planet.
  • Due to the different fabrics used in both garments, the colour tones may vary.

products.title: The Mandarin Set
products.body_html:
• A set of two of our signature styles, the Mandarin Collar Top and the Basic Pyjamas in indigo, the perfect pair for lounging.
  • Crafted in light and crisp organic cotton, the mandarin collar and relaxed cut of the top makes it perfect for work. The pyjama features an a-line silhouette that ends in a gentle flare.
  • The indigo hue makes this matching set an easy pick to spend sunny days in, whether you’re lounging by the pool or off to a breezy brunch.

products.title: The Basic Mid Length Kurta Set - Olive
products.body_html:
• The Basic Mid Length Kurta Set pairs the Basic Mid Length Kurta with our signature Basic Pyjamas, bringing an easy, relaxed take to everyday dressing in a versatile olive hue.
  • The Basic Mid Length Kurta is crafted in Bemberg, a smooth, lightweight and fluid fabric with a soft drape that keeps it comfortable through the day. Made from cotton linter, a natural byproduct of cottonseed oil production, Bemberg is a regenerated cellulose fibre that is soft, breathable and gentle on the skin.
  • A relaxed cut and side slits allow for easy movement, while the clean neckline and simple placket keep the silhouette pared back.
  • Our classic Nico star sits discreetly beneath the placket, while a playful elephant motif at the back adds a signature detail to the Basic Mid Length Kurta.
  • The Basic Pyjamas are crafted in soft, lightweight cotton silk and fall in our signature A-line silhouette, ending in a gentle flare. The relaxed shape gives plenty of room to move throughout the day.
  • Wear The Basic Mid Length Kurta Set together with sneakers or open-toed sandals, or style the Basic Mid Length Kurta and Basic Pyjamas separately with pieces already in your wardrobe.

products.title: The Lazy Sunday Tunic Set
products.body_html:
• Crafted for ease, The Lazy Sunday Tunic Set pairs the Lazy Sunday Tunic with our signature Basic Pyjamas, bringing together an effortless silhouette in a versatile olive hue.
  • The Lazy Sunday Tunic is crafted in Bemberg, a smooth, lightweight and breathable fabric with a fluid drape that keeps the relaxed silhouette feeling refined. The easy cut and airy batwing sleeves make it comfortable for all-day wear
  • A playful star embroidery at the back adds a signature detail to the Lazy Sunday Tunic.
  • The Basic Pyjamas are crafted in soft, lightweight cotton silk and fall in our signature A-line silhouette, ending in a gentle flare. The relaxed shape gives plenty of room to move throughout the day.
  • Wear The Lazy Sunday Tunic Set together with sneakers or open-toed sandals, or style the Lazy Sunday Tunic and Basic Pyjamas separately with pieces already in your wardrobe.

products.title: The Singha Rakhi Set
products.body_html:
• A rakhi and a keepsake mug, together for the day and every morning after, the Singha Rakhi Set makes gifting memorable.
  • The rakhi's letter S motif is crafted in brass with 18 carat pure gold plating, tied onto an aqua cotton thread.
  • The Singha Mug is thrown in smooth stoneware, its fresh design a small love letter to India's regional dialects and scripts.
  • The rakhi comes in a ready-to-ship giftable envelope, with a card inside to hold your thoughts even closer.

products.title: Alphabet S Rakhi Set
products.body_html:
• A rakhi and a keepsake glass carrying the same initial, the Alphabet S Rakhi Set is a gift that's personal from every angle.
  • The rakhi's letter S motif is crafted in brass with 18 carat pure gold plating, tied onto an aqua cotton thread.
  • The Alphabet Glass - S is crafted in borosilicate, light and practical, with the initial rendered in Nicobar's signature typography.
  • The rakhi comes in a ready-to-ship giftable envelope, with a card inside to hold your thoughts even closer.

products.title: Alphabet S Rakhi Set
products.body_html:
• The Alphabet S Rakhi Set celebrates the little details that make every bond feel personal.
  • It includes our Alphabet S Rakhi and Alphabet S Bag Charm, pairing a meaningful keepsake with an everyday companion.
  • The rakhi is crafted in brass with 18 carat pure gold plating and tied with an aqua cotton thread, while the Alphabet S Bag Charm is handcrafted in brass with rhodium plating and finished with a circle ring lock to clip onto your favourite bag.
  • Beautifully presented in a ready-to-ship giftable envelope with a card inside to hold your thoughts even closer.
  • Thoughtful together, timeless forever, they're gifts made to be cherished long after Raksha Bandhan.

products.title: The Sitara Rakhi Set
products.body_html:
• The Sitara Rakhi Set celebrates the little details that make every bond feel personal.
  • It includes our Alphabet S Rakhi and Sitara Pouch, pairing a meaningful keepsake with an everyday essential.
  • The rakhi is crafted in brass with 18 carat pure gold plating and tied with an aqua cotton thread, while the Sitara Pouch is crafted in printed fabric with a secure zipper closure and leather puller to keep everyday essentials organised.
  • Beautifully presented in a ready-to-ship giftable envelope with a card inside to hold your thoughts even closer.
  • Thoughtful together, timeless forever, they're gifts made to be cherished long after Raksha Bandhan.

products.title: Mandovi Dinner Set - Set of 2
products.body_html:
• Hand-painted foliage, organic forms, and a sun-washed palette—this stoneware set brings a touch of the tropics to every meal.
  • Includes: 4 dinner plates, 4 quarter plates, 4 katoris, and 4 kulhars.
  • Perfect for hosting long, leisurely meals with a side of stories.

products.title: Lama Smocked Kurta - Electric Blue
products.body_html:
• Comfort and style come together with Nicobar’s Lama Smocked kurta. Crafted in cotton silk, the kurta is perfect for when you wish to dress it up a bit.
  • The kurta has tattoo inspired embroidery on the pockets and the back.
  • Add Nicobar’s Electric Blue Basic Pyjamas to complete the look.

products.title: Dori Blouse - Cotton Silk Fitted
products.body_html:
• NicoBaraat has arrived! Timeless pieces reimagined for the people who make weddings the joyful chaos that they are.
  • The Dori Blouse in check is a fitted crop woven in purple and chartreuse, with lotuses embroidered across the check.
  • The purple and chartreuse check is yarn dyed, so it is woven into the fabric.
  • Lotus motifs in pitta work are placed all over the check.
  • Fitted and cropped, with a V-neck and half sleeves, and a berry cotton silk dori tied at the back.
  • There is no top stitch, so the seams stay clean.

products.title: Poppy Wall Art - Blue
products.body_html:
• A poppy in full bloom, framed in glass and set against a rich blue background.
  • Made from MDF and aluminium with a matte finish, this compact wall piece brings colour and character to a shelf, bedside or gallery wall.
  • At 8 x 8 x 10 cm, it is an easy way to bring a little art into the everyday.
  • Great to gift or to keep.

products.title: Poppy Wall Art - Red
products.body_html:
• A poppy in full bloom, framed in glass and set against a rich red background.
  • Made from MDF and aluminium with a matte finish, this compact wall piece brings colour and character to a shelf, bedside or gallery wall.
  • At 8 x 8 x 10 cm, it is an easy way to bring a little art into the everyday.
  • Great to gift or to keep.

products.title: Sail Boat Home Accent - Large
products.body_html:
• A model sailing boat built from wood and canvas: a wooden hull, canvas sails and rigging strung between them.
  • The large size has more sail to show and more rigging to look at, and stands on a sideboard or a mantel.
  • A boat under sail is a fair emblem for a wedding: two people, one direction.

products.title: Memoir Photo Frame - Set of 2
products.body_html:
• Two resin frames in a pair of colours, a sea green and a blush, with small gold flowers set around the edges.
  • A matte finish lets the gold flowers do the shining.
  • Sold as a pair.

products.title: Sail Boat Home Accent - Small
products.body_html:
• A model sailing boat built from wood and canvas: a wooden hull, canvas sails and rigging strung between them.
  • The small size is made for a desk, a bookshelf or a console table.
  • A boat under sail is a fair emblem for a wedding: two people, one direction.

products.title: Veranda Tea Set
products.body_html:
• Veranda is where the house meets the garden, and where tea gets poured. This set brings sixteen pieces to that table: two sets of four cups and saucers, one with glass cups and one in bone china.
  • A palm is printed in green on the cups and saucers, with a green border on the saucers.
  • The glass cups have a glossy finish, and the bone china cups a matte one.
  • The cup and saucer are a new shape for the brand.
  • Dimensions: Cup - D6.2xH9.6 Cm, Plate - D12.1xH2.2 Cm, Cup - D6.1x8 Cm & Plate - D13xH2cm

products.title: Solace Dressingrobe Set
products.body_html:
• A pair of dressing robes for two, in a digital print of green: hers a botanical print of blooms and leaves, his a vertical stripe in green and ivory.
  • Each robe borrows from the other: the stripe of his trims her collar and cuffs, and his collar and cuffs come in the green of her print.
  • Cut in a silk blend and tied with a belt at the waist.

  • Sizes: Dressing Robe for Him – 119 cm (S–M); Dressing Robe for Her – 107 cm (S–M)

products.title: Ember Candle Holder and Taper Candle Set
products.body_html:
• An organic shape gives each holder its character: a fluted cup that opens like a petal, held up on a tall green stem, one in blush glass and one in claret.
  • A pair of taper candles comes with the holders, so the table is laid the moment the box is open.
  • Lit, the coloured glass carries the flame in blush and claret.
  • Dimensions: Candle Holder - L8 x W8 x H14 cm & Candles - L2.4 x W2.4 x H 25.8 cm

products.title: Chand Madhu Set
products.body_html:
• Chand means moon, and the round spice box at the heart of this set takes its name from the shape: a glass lid over steel compartments, on a wooden base.
  • The spice box comes with two spoons.
  • A brass ghee pot with a ladle sits alongside it, in a matte gold finish.
  • The steel and brass are finished in matte, silver against gold, with the warm brown of the wood between them.
  • Dimensions: Spice Box - L15 x W15 x H4 Cm & Ghee Pot - L6 x W6 Cm

products.title: Saanjh Shawl - Chartreuse
products.body_html:
• A chartreuse shawl with gota flowers and leaves worked into the corners, and a fine gota border along the edges.
  • Woven in 100% wool, with small sequin accents and tassels at the ends.
  • Saanjh means dusk, and the colour is meant to glow like it.

products.title: Bahaar Shawl - Violet
products.body_html:
• A violet shawl dotted all over with small silver accents, with a border of embroidered flowers along one edge.
  • Woven in 100% wool, a new material direction for the collection's shawls, it brings warmth and a touch of glamour to the outfit.
  • Finished with a check trim and tassels at the ends.

products.title: Firefly Potli - Chartreuse
products.body_html:
• A chartreuse potli with gota flowers embroidered across in gold and silver colours.
  • Beaded drawstrings gather the top and end in fuchsia and purple tassels.
  • It carries the wedding season's brightest colour.

products.title: Meher Potli - Violet
products.body_html:
• A violet potli scattered with heart-shaped mirrors, each held in place by jali thread work in a different colour.
  • A black-and-white check drawstring gathers the top into a ruffled edge, finished with berry-toned beaded tassels.
  • Made for the wedding season, from haldi and mehendi to the cocktail evening.

products.title: Chandphool Ring - Gold
products.body_html:
• A crescent of mirror sits in a gold setting shaped like the chandphool, the crescent flower from the collection.
  • Handcrafted in brass and 18k gold-plated, in the mirror work traditionally worn to ward off the evil eye.
  • Made to sit alongside the Chand Maangtika.

products.title: Pipit Pocket Squares - Pure SIlk
products.body_html:
• The Pipet pocket squares from the Rajesh Pratap Singh x Nicobar collection is crafted in pure silk, printed in an abstract multicolour pattern.
  • Finished with a baby roll hemline, hand-stitched in contrast thread, kept simple so the print does the work.
  • Works perfectly for a breast pocket

products.title: Drongo Pocket Squares - Pure Silk
products.body_html:
• The Drongo pocket squares from the Rajesh Pratap Singh x Nicobar collection, is crafted in pure silk, printed in an abstract multicolour pattern.
  • Finished with a baby roll hemline, hand-stitched in contrast thread, kept simple so the print does the work.
  • Works perfectly for a breast pocket

products.title: Chand Maangtika - Gold
products.body_html:
• A fine chain leads to a small flower, a diamond and a crescent of mirror, tipped with gold points.
  • Handcrafted in brass and 18k gold-plated, in mirror work that dates back to the 17th century and is rooted in Rajasthan and Gujarat.
  • Mirrors are traditionally worn to ward off the evil eye, so the maangtika is as much a talisman as an ornament.

products.title: Masse Pin - Gold
products.body_html:
• A fish with a scaled, textured body with dark red glass drop beneath it, with two chains looping below and ending in a gold bead and a second glass drop.
  • Handcrafted in brass and 18k gold-plated, made to pin onto a saree, a jacket or a scarf.
  • The fish adds much needed whimsy to a statement piece.

products.title: Kaveri Bangle - Gold
products.body_html:
• A textured gold band is crossed by two slim wires, like a river's channels meeting and parting.
  • Handcrafted in brass and 18k gold-plated, with small dots worked into the band.
  • Named for the river the whole collection is built around, and worn as a stack in a single bangle.

products.title: Mari-Palm Hairpin - Gold
products.body_html:
• A fan of gold petals edged in tiny beads, with a zircon at its centre, is fixed to a slim pin.
  • Handcrafted in brass and 18k gold-plated, made to slide into a bun or a braid.
  • A giftable new design in the collection, made for the wedding day and beyond.

products.title: Mari-Palm Earrings - Gold
products.body_html:
• Marigold and palm come together in a fan of green glass petals around a textured gold centre, with a small pink stone at its heart.
  • Handcrafted in brass and 18k gold-plated, worn as a stud with a small teardrop below.
  • An earring that sits close to the ear and still makes a statement.

products.title: Marigold Earrings - Gold
products.body_html:
• A domed centre of layered petals, set with a small zircon, sits inside an openwork fan edged with pearls.
  • Handcrafted in brass and 18k gold-plated, hung from a slim hook.
  • The marigold is an essential wedding flower and it is worked here in gold and pearl.

products.title: Darbaar Bali - Green
products.body_html:
• A bali built on a crescent-horned frame, set with three green glass stones and hung with small gold drops.
  • Handcrafted in brass, this is a new green colourway of the Darbaar Bali.
  • Deep in colour, it works with both traditional and contemporary wedding wear.

products.title: Clover Necklace - Gold
products.body_html:
• Clover-shaped links, each set with green glass, sit along the collarbone and fall into a drop of three at the centre.
  • Handcrafted in brass and 18k gold-plated, made to work with the Clover Kanauti.
  • The clover is one of the garden series' recurring shapes, repeated here as a chain.

products.title: Clover Kanauti - Gold
products.body_html:
• A double chain of fine gold links runs along the curve of the ear and ends in a clover set with green glass, with a second stone dangling below.
  • Handcrafted in brass and 18k gold-plated, with small fan detailing worked into the links.
  • An ear chain that brings the collection's clover motif up and along the ear.

products.title: Kesar Phool Studs - Gold
products.body_html:
• A single flower built from layered gold petals, with an amethyst set at its heart.
  • Handcrafted in brass and 18k gold-plated.
  • The smallest piece in the kesar phool set, made to sit alongside the choker and cuff.

products.title: Kesar Phool Cuff - Gold
products.body_html:
• Three flowers sit along a slim open cuff, dotted with an amethyst at the centre.
  • Handcrafted in brass and 18k gold-plated, with layered petals worked for depth.
  • Part of the kesar phool set, made to go with the choker and studs.

products.title: Anar Bagicha Necklace - Gold
products.body_html:
• Faceted garnet beads run down to a textured gold pomegranate, with small gold accents tucked between the stones.
  • Handcrafted in brass and 18k gold-plated, strung with garnet cut to resemble the arils of the fruit.
  • The garnet bagicha is the orchard, and the pendant at the centre is the fruit itself.

products.title: Kesar Choker - Gold
products.body_html:
• Three textured gold flowers, each with an amethyst at its centre, are joined by curling tendrils, with chalcedony drops in pale aqua beneath.
  • Handcrafted in brass and 18k gold-plated, on a slim snake chain with a slider to adjust the fit.
  • A piece where florals are worked in layered petals rather than drawn flat.

products.title: Anar Ring - Gold
products.body_html:
• Three pomegranates in blue enamel, sit on a gold-toned face with a scalloped edge.
  • Handcrafted in brass and finished in enamel.
  • An anaar interpretation that moves from red to blue, standing apart from the rest of the anaar family.

products.title: Anaar Bagicha Earring - Gold
products.body_html:
• A gold pomegranate sits at the ear with a cluster of garnet falling from it, a bagicha, or small orchard, of arils.
  • Handcrafted in brass and 18k gold-plated, with the garnet shaved to resemble the arils of the fruit.
  • Garnet takes its name from the pomegranate, and this earring takes that connection seriously.

products.title: Pom Pearl Brooch - Gold
products.body_html:
• The same pomegranate as the Pom Pearl Drops, turned into a brooch: a red glass bulb under a gold crown.
  • Handcrafted in brass and 18k gold-plated, with small pearls at the base and a pearl drop hanging below.
  • A giftable piece, made for a saree pallu, a lapel or a scarf.

products.title: Pom Pearl Drops - Gold
products.body_html:
• A pomegranate rendered as a single glass bulb, capped with a gold crown and held in a fleur-like setting.
  • Handcrafted in brass and 18k gold-plated, with small pearls at the base and a pearl drop below.
  • The anaar is one of the collection's recurring motifs, worked here as a small, polished fruit.

products.title: Gul Haathphool - Gold
products.body_html:
• A classic haath-phool reimagined in a cascade of crescents set with pink glass, resting across the back of the hand.
  • Handcrafted in brass and 18k gold-plated, with signature Nico stars along the bracelet that fastens at the wrist.
  • One of the collection's new silhouettes, with the stars on the wrist bringing a touch of Nicobar whimsy.

products.title: Gul-Chand Necklace - Gold
products.body_html:
• Crescents cascade in tiers to a point at the centre, each set with pink glass in the spirit of chand polki jewellery.
  • Handcrafted in brass and 18k gold-plated, with signature Nico stars along the top and finished with delicate pearl drops.
  • An adjustable slider chain lets it sit exactly where you want it accentuating the collarbone.

products.title: Gul-Chand Earring - Gold
products.body_html:
• Three crescents stack beneath one another, each set with pink glass in the spirit of Mughal-era chand polki jewellery.
  • Handcrafted in brass and plated in 18k gold, hung from a star shaped gold stud and finished with a single pearl at the base.
  • An ode to a long-preserved tradition and technique.

products.title: Dori Blouse - Cotton Silk Fitted
products.body_html:
• NicoBaraat has arrived! Timeless pieces reimagined for the people who make weddings the joyful chaos that they are.
  • The Dori Blouse is a fitted crop in the Guldasta print, tied at the back with a red dori that ends in a bunch of sequin flowers.
  • Cut fitted and cropped in cotton silk, with half sleeves, in a small purple Guldasta print all over.
  • Sequins are worked over the print, giving the blooms points of shine.
  • Black and white tiny check piping runs along the neckline, hem and sleeves, and loops and a button in the print fabric close the blouse.
  • There is no top stitch, so the seams stay clean.

products.title: Vida Sari - Embroidered Tissue
products.body_html:
• NicoBaraat has arrived! Timeless pieces reimagined for the people who make weddings the joyful chaos that they are.
  • The Vida Sari is striped in silver and gold tissue, with red flowers embroidered across the stripes.
  • Yarn-dyed organza tissue, woven with silver and gold stripes that catch light as the sari moves.
  • Red flowers are embroidered all over in thread, worked in cradle embroidery.
  • A gota border runs along the edge, with red organic cotton voile binding.
  • A baby hem finishes the inside, and tassels hang from both ends of the pallu.

products.title: Shagun Sari - Embroidered Mukaish Silk Organza
products.body_html:
• NicoBaraat has arrived! Timeless pieces reimagined for the people who make weddings the joyful chaos that they are.
  • Shagun means a good omen, and the Shagun Sari answers with green silk organza set all over with silver mukaish.
  • A green base of silk organza, hand embroidered all over in silver mukaish.
  • Berry cotton silk binds three sides of the sari, a deeper colour against the green.
  • A baby hem finishes the inside, and tassels hang from both ends of the pallu.

products.title: Milan Sari - Embroidered Mukaish Silk Organza
products.body_html:
• NicoBaraat has arrived! Timeless pieces reimagined for the people who make weddings the joyful chaos that they are.
  • Milan means union, and the Milan Sari is berry silk organza set all over with silver mukaish.
  • 100% silk organza in berry, hand embroidered all over in silver mukaish.
  • Chartreuse cotton silk binds three sides of the sari, so the berry sits against a bright edge.
  • A baby hem finishes the inside, and tassels hang from both ends of the pallu.

products.title: Ishara Dupatta - Embroidered Silk Kota
products.body_html:
• NicoBaraat has arrived! Timeless pieces reimagined for the people who make weddings the joyful chaos that they are.
  • Ishara means a sign, the glance across the mandap that says everything, and the Ishara Dupatta answers it in pink silk kota worked with gold gota.
  • 100% silk kota, the light, open weave of Rajasthan, in pink.
  • Gold gota flowers are worked across the pink base in cradle embroidery.
  • Tassels hang from two opposite corners.

products.title: Adaa Dupatta - Embroidered Mukaish Silk Organza
products.body_html:
• NicoBaraat has arrived! Timeless pieces reimagined for the people who make weddings the joyful chaos that they are.
  • Adaa means grace of manner, and this sea foam dupatta has it in every fold of its drape.
  • Silk organza in sea foam, sheer and crisp, hand embroidered all over with mukaish.
  • Mukaish is the metal-wire work of Lucknow, set in small points, and here the points cover the organza from edge to edge.
  • Chartreuse cotton silk binds all four sides, giving the sheer fabric a defined border.
  • Tassels hang from two opposite corners.

products.title: Saaya Skirt - Foil Printed Cotton Silk
products.body_html:
• NicoBaraat has arrived! Timeless pieces reimagined for the people who make weddings the joyful chaos that they are.
  • The Saaya Skirt lays foil flowers across purple cotton silk and turns red at the hem.
  • A long, flared skirt in cotton silk, in purple with a dual tone flower foil print all over and a solid purple waistband.
  • Hand embroidery lifts onto the foil print, adding thread to the flowers so they gain texture.
  • A red organic cotton voile facing extends the hem, and the tassel flower at the side ties is bound in the same red.
  • Black and white tiny check dori ties end in tassels, and gota lace edges the hem.

products.title: Berura Skirt - Cotton Kora Flared Fit
products.body_html:
• NicoBaraat has arrived! Timeless pieces reimagined for the people who make weddings the joyful chaos that they are.
  • The Berura Skirt is a long chartreuse flare in cotton kora, with a berry tassel flower at the side.
  • Cotton kora forms both the body and the lining, in solid chartreuse.
  • Long and flared, it ties at the side with dori in black and white tiny checks that end in tassels.
  • Berry cotton silk extends the hemline as a facing, and the tassel flower is made from the same berry, a bright turn from the chartreuse.
  • Gota lace edges the hem, with a small embroidered icon on the skirt.

products.title: Sagan Sharara - Foil Printed Cotton Silk
products.body_html:
• NicoBaraat has arrived! Timeless pieces reimagined for the people who make weddings the joyful chaos that they are.
  • Sagan means an auspicious token, and the Sagan Sharara scatters a sky of stars across purple.
  • A long, flared sharara in cotton silk, in purple with a dual tone star foil print all over.
  • The foil catches light in two tones, so the stars shift as the fabric moves.
  • Side ties in purple and chartreuse checks end in tassels, and an elastic waistband sets the fit.
  • A chartreuse cotton kora facing extends the hem, edged with gota lace, with a small embroidered icon on the sharara.

products.title: Novel Pants - Viscose Silk Blend Narrow Fit
products.body_html:
• NicoBaraat has arrived! Timeless pieces reimagined for the people who make weddings the joyful chaos that they are.
  • The Novel Pants take red, the colour of the wedding day, and cut it narrow.
  • Cut in a viscose silk blend, these long trousers have a narrow fit, a concealed zip at the side seam and an elastic waistband at the back.
  • Patra embroidery runs down both side seams and ends in a small blue heart, a detail that shows as you walk.
  • A single embroidered icon sits at the front hemline.
  • Pockets in the same fabric and hanger loops finish the inside.

products.title: Milni Kurta - Embroidered Silk
products.body_html:
• NicoBaraat has arrived! Timeless pieces reimagined for the people who make weddings the joyful chaos that they are.
  • The Milni Kurta is named for the moment two families meet at the wedding door, and it dresses for that meeting in fuchsia silk.
  • Cut in 100% silk, this is a long, regular-fit kurta with a round neck, three-quarter sleeves and pockets.
  • Cradle embroidery in patra and gota covers the silk from neckline to hem.
  • Triangle gold gota finishes the side slits, the hemline and the sleeve hems, and red facings and piping frame the slits.
  • Turn back a facing and black and white tiny checks line the inside.

products.title: Sehra Kurti - Cotton Silk Printed
products.body_html:
• NicoBaraat has arrived! Timeless pieces reimagined for the people who make weddings the joyful chaos that they are.
  • The Sehra Kurti takes its name from the strands of flowers a groom wears across his face, and carries a bouquet of small purple blooms across its cotton silk.
  • Cut in cotton silk, this is a short, regular-fit kurti with a U-neck and three-quarter sleeves.
  • The small Guldasta print in purple spreads across the whole kurti. Hand embroidery traces over the print, lifting the blooms with thread and sequin.
  • Red cotton silk finishes the hem as a broad facing and extends into piping along the neckline and sleeve hems.
  • A sequin strip and a thin gota lace run along the neckline and sleeve hems, with sleeve piping in black and white tiny checks.

products.title: Ibex Trousers - Sand
products.body_html:
• The Ibex Trousers, from the Rajesh Pratap Singh x Nicobar collection, are day trousers in sand linen, named for the ibex, the goat that climbs where others do not.
  • 100% linen in a bottom weight, heavier than shirting linen, piece dyed in a natural beige called sand.
  • Solid, long, and cut for the office as much as the weekend.

products.title: Serow Jodhpur Pants - Black
products.body_html:
• The Serow Jodhpur Pants, from the Rajesh Pratap Singh x Nicobar collection, are cut in black stretch cotton twill and named for the serow, the goat-antelope of the hills.
  • Cotton twill with stretch, piece dyed in solid black, in a long length.
  • The jodhpur cut is the traditional trouser under a bandhgala.

products.title: Hawai Sa Kurta - Dark Blue
products.body_html:
• The Hawai Sa Kurta, from the Rajesh Pratap Singh x Nicobar collection, is a short kurta in dark blue cotton, with a tonal aeroplane buti printed on the same blue.
  • 100% cotton with a digital print, cut in the Pathan suit shape with a regular collar and full sleeves.
  • The tonal print is visible up close and easy to miss from a distance.

products.title: Langur Polo T-Shirt - Brown & Pink
products.body_html:
• The Langur Polo, from the Rajesh Pratap Singh x Nicobar collection, is a polo in brown and pink, named for the langur, with a geometric pattern and embroidery.
  • 100% cotton flat knit in yarn-dyed brown and pink, with a geometric pattern.
  • A regular collar and full sleeves.

products.title: Tahr Bandhgala - Ivory
products.body_html:
• The Tahr Bandhgala, from the Rajesh Pratap Singh x Nicobar collection, is cut in ivory linen and named for the tahr, the wild goat of the mountains.
  • 100% linen, piece dyed in solid ivory, with full sleeves.
  • A solid ivory jacket leaves a printed or coloured kurta underneath to carry the pattern.

products.title: Macaque Polo T-Shirt - Ivory & Sand
products.body_html:
• The Macaque Polo, from the Rajesh Pratap Singh x Nicobar collection, is striped in ivory and sand and named for the macaque, with a monkey embroidered to make the point.
  • 100% cotton flat knit, with the stripes dyed into the yarn before it is knitted.
  • A regular collar and full sleeves.

products.title: The Lily Pond Set
products.body_html:
• The Lily Pond Set, crafted in stoneware, is a layered ode to garden stillness, designed to bring richness and detail to every meal.
  • The Lotus Garden Shallow Bowls, a set of two, feature lotus blooms, lily pads, koi fish, and Kingfisher birds surrounded by dotted clouds and soft green swirls, creating a story that unfolds with every glance.
  • The Lotus Garden Curry Bowl carries the motif inside and out, with lotus and lily pads flowing over a charcoal base for striking contrast.
  • The Lily Pond Chip & Dip Platter is framed with signature charcoal stripes, its centre a lively scene of blooms, leaves, and a resting monkey, adding a playful note to the table.

products.title: Ceylon Trail Set
products.body_html:
• Island lush beckons with the Ceylon Trail Set, perfect for a tea, coffee and nibbles. The set includes the Ceylon Trail Cookie Tray with Tong, the Ceylon Trail Tea plates - Set of 4 and Ceylon Trail Espresso Mugs - Set of 4.
  • High-tea has never looked better -the Ceylon Trail Cookie Tray is perfect for all your confections with an accompanying tong.
  • Drenched in whimsy, the Ceylon Tea Plates feature a cheeky pink monkey perched atop lush Sri Lankan foliage.
  • The Ceylon Trail Espresso Mugs are the perfect addition to elevate your everyday brews - your espresso has never been better.

products.title: The Ananas Rakhi Set
products.body_html:
• A rakhi and a keepsake mug, together for the day and every morning after, the Ananas Rakhi Set makes gifting memorable.
  • The rakhi's letter A motif is crafted in brass with 18 carat pure gold plating, tied onto an aqua cotton thread.
  • The Ananas Mug is thrown in smooth stoneware, its fresh design a small love letter to India's regional dialects and scripts.
  • The rakhi comes in a ready-to-ship giftable envelope, with a card inside to hold your thoughts even closer.

products.title: Alphabet A Rakhi Set
products.body_html:

  • The Alphabet Glass - A is crafted in borosilicate, light and practical, with the initial rendered in Nicobar's signature typography.
  • The rakhi comes in a ready-to-ship giftable envelope, with a card inside to hold your thoughts even closer.

products.title: Rit Tumbler - Set of 4
products.body_html:
• Four glass tumblers, each handpainted with a single flower: a cornflower, a poppy, a carnation and a daisy, finished with a fine coloured line around the rim.
  • Clear glass lets each bloom float against whatever is poured into it.
  • Straight-sided and short, with the familiar shape of a water glass rather than a wine glass.

products.title: The Cirrus Shirt Set
products.body_html:
• A modern classic, The Cirrus Shirt Set pairs the Cirrus Shirt with our signature Basic Pyjamas, bringing an easy polish to everyday dressing in a versatile olive hue.
  • The Cirrus Shirt is crafted in cotton silk, a soft, lightweight and breathable fabric with a fluid drape that keeps the relaxed silhouette feeling refined. The boxy cut and easy shape make it comfortable for all-day wear.
  • An embroidered heart at the back adds a playful signature detail to the Cirrus Shirt
  • The Basic Pyjamas are crafted in soft, lightweight cotton silk and fall in our signature A-line silhouette, ending in a gentle flare. The relaxed shape gives plenty of room to move throughout the day.
  • Wear The Cirrus Shirt Set together for an effortless, polished look, or style the Cirrus Shirt and Basic Pyjamas separately with pieces already in your wardrobe.

products.title: The Ayat Kurta Set - Green & Fuchsia Printed
products.body_html:
• Crafted for both quiet mornings and lively evenings, this set brings together soft florals and a relaxed silhouette for a look that’s thoughtful yet dressy.
  • The Ayat Kurta is celebratory, patterned with delicate vintage pink florals on a fresh green base. Lightweight and breathable, it’s crafted for effortless comfort in both movement and mood.
  • The Novel Narrow Pants feature a soft green base adorned with delicate pink vintage floral prints—bringing a hint of nostalgia to everyday dressing. Crafted in lightweight 100% organic cotton voile.

products.title: The Lazy Sunday Tunic Set - Orange
products.body_html:
• The Lazy Sunday Tunic Set pairs the iconic Lazy Sunday Tunic with Perch Pants in vibrant orange, made for bold summer days.
  • The tunic is crafted in yarn dyed cotton with all over chikankari embroidery and signature red heart detailing at the back yoke.
  • The pants feature a ditsy ice twig print on orange voile, finished with an ice blue heart embroidery placed at the bottom hem beside the side seam.
  • Together, the set brings colour, craft, and effortless Nicobar ease in one look.

products.title: Myra Dinner Set (For 2)
products.body_html:
• The Myra Dinner Set for two is fesh, botanical and inspired by our travels to Tibet.
  • The set comes with two pieces each of the Myra Dinner Plate, Myra Quarter Plate, Myra Katori and Myra Curry Bowl.
  • Perfect for everyday and special occasions.
  • Dimensions - Myra Dinner Plate : 26 cm, Myra Quarter Plate - Emerald : 18 x 2 cm, Myra Katori : 11 x 6 cm, Myra Curry Bowl : 21 x 8 cm

products.title: The Floating Lotus Set
products.body_html:
• The Floating Lotus Set, crafted in stoneware, is a vibrant mix of pattern and storytelling, designed to make every sip and bite feel like a small celebration.
  • The Float Espresso Mugs feature lush greens, lotus blooms, and playful monkeys with gold accents, turning your morning or post-dinner coffee into a moment of joy.
  • The Float Tea Plates echo the same spirit — one with a soft grey base and a drifting lily pad, the other crisp white with monkeys, lotuses, and hints of gold — perfect for desserts or teatime snacks.
  • Together, this set layers colour, craft, and a touch of festivity into your everyday table.

products.body_html:
