products.title: The Teatime Set
products.body_html:
• Begin the day with quiet ritual in our Teatime Set, complete with two Dessert Plates and two Conical mugs to make your mornings perfect.
  • Crafted in stoneware with a sleek conical silhouette our cups are a visual lift to your everyday cuppa. Mug capacity : 300ml.
  • From chai to coffee, they bring colour, craft, and a little bit of Indus charm to the table.
  • Excellent to gift or keep.

products.title: Brass Fez Dinner Set
products.body_html:
• Thalis, katoris, and curry bowls come together in the Brass Fez Dinner Set for 4—featuring the 4 x Madhu Thali, 4 x Fez Quarter Plates, 4 x Madhu Katoris, 1 x Fez Curry Bowls, 1 x Sitara Spoons (Set of 4), 2 x Sitara Fork & Knives (Set of 4), and 4 x Madhu Glasses.
  • With its modern take on the traditional brass, The Madhu dinner pieces are one of our festive favourites.
  • The Fez dinner pieces feature geometric tiling in shades of charcoal and soft grey by way of Sri Lanka's tropical modernism
  • Set the table and create a stellar culinary experience with our Sitara cutlery set.

products.title: Heritage Churn Set
products.body_html:
• Reminiscent of Nani's home, the Heritage Churn Set features the Madhu Glass and the Dariya Lota and Churner Set.
  • With its modern take on traditional brass, the Madhu Glass is one of our new favourites.
  • Crafted in brass with a matte gold finish, Dariya Lota & Churner Set comes with a sturdy wooden churner

products.title: The Firefly Shirt Set
products.body_html:
• Firefly, our muse for the festive season, takes inspiration from the delicate, fleeting glow of fireflies that appear at dusk and make the night feel a little more magical. The Firefly Shirt Set brings that spirit to luminous metallic tissue, pairing a striped shirt with easy black A-line pants.
  • The Firefly Shirt features a loose fit with multicoloured vertical stripes and a softly reflective finish. Bias-cut cuffs shift the direction of the stripes, while red thread fagotting follows the shoulder and armhole seams. An Anaar Patra icon sits at the back, with an embroidered detail tucked below the collar.
  • The Charisma Pants are cut in black metallic tissue with a relaxed A-line fit and elasticated waistband. Red thread fagotting runs across the leg panels, while black rainbow sequin pintucks and a zardozi fish embroidery finish the hem.
  • Wear the set for festive lunches, gatherings and easy celebrations, or style the pieces separately.

products.title: The Lazy Sunday Tunic Set
products.body_html:
• Firefly, our muse for the festive season, takes inspiration from the delicate, fleeting glow of fireflies that appear at dusk and make the night feel a little more magical. The Lazy Sunday Tunic Set brings that darker evening mood to charcoal and black, pairing a printed cotton silk tunic with fluid metallic tissue pants.
  • Cut in cotton silk, the Lazy Sunday Tunic features a loose, mid-length silhouette with a mandarin collar and full cuffed sleeves. A charcoal and gunmetal Bidri-inspired floral print brings metallic depth to the black base, while a green star embroidery at the centre back and berry bead at the neckline add unexpected colour.
  • The matching Charisma Pants are cut in black metallic tissue with a relaxed A-line fit and elasticated waistband. Red thread faggoting defines the leg panels, while black rainbow sequin pintucks and a small red heart embroidery add texture at the hem.
  • Wear the set for evening dinners, festive nights and occasions that call for something understated.

products.title: The Front Pleated Kurta Set
products.body_html:
• The Front Pleated Kurta Set brings that feeling to green and blue stripes, pairing a pleated kurta with narrow striped pants.
  • Cut in Organ, the Front Pleated Kurta has a V-neckline edged in red beads, front pleats and full sleeves finished with twisted loop gold lace. Gold foil buttas are scattered across the stripes.
  • The matching Arzoie Pants are cut in organic cotton voile with a narrow fit, an elasticated waistband and a small zardozi elephant at the hem.
  • Wear the set for festive lunches and mehendis, or style the pieces separately.

products.title: The Viva Kurta Set
products.body_html:
• Firefly, our muse for the festive season, takes inspiration from the delicate, fleeting glow of fireflies that appear at dusk and make the night feel a little more magical. The Viva Kurta Set brings that feeling to bright chartreuse, pairing an embellished cotton silk kurta with easy A-line pyjamas.
  • Cut in cotton silk, the Viva Kurta features a long A-line silhouette with a V-neckline and three-quarter cuffed sleeves. An all-over foil and pigment print is complemented by gold zari bondi and a fine zari jali at the neckline, while twisted loop antique gold lace finishes the cuffs.
  • The matching Basic Pyjamas are cut in cotton silk with an easy A-line silhouette designed for comfort and movement. A small Gota Chakri flower embroidery at the bottom of one leg adds a crafted detail to the clean shape.
  • Wear the set for festive lunches, gatherings and easy celebrations, or style the pieces separately.

products.title: The Tango Kaftan Set
products.body_html:
• Firefly, our muse for the festive season, takes inspiration from the delicate, fleeting glow of fireflies that appear at dusk and make the night feel a little more magical. The Tango Kaftan Set brings that feeling to molten gold metallic tissue, pairing an easy kaftan with fluid A-line pants.
  • Cut in metallic tissue, the Tango Kaftan features a free-size silhouette with a V-neckline, half sleeves and a fluid pleated back. Stone motifs across the front add texture, while hand tacking on the concealed placket completes the construction.
  • The matching Charisma Pants are cut in metallic tissue with an elasticated A-line fit that falls fluidly through the leg. Red thread faggoting defines the leg panels, while red tulip embroidery with a cobalt blue detail adds a small contrast of colour near the hem.
  • Wear the set for festive evenings, dinners and celebrations, or style the pieces separately for a more relaxed take.

products.title: The Moonbeam Kurta Set
products.body_html:
• Firefly, our muse for the festive season, takes inspiration from the delicate, fleeting glow of fireflies that appear at dusk and make the night feel a little more magical. The Moonbeam Kurta and Stellar Pants bring that feeling to deep black, pairing an embroidered cotton silk kurta with easy organic cotton voile pants.
  • Cut in cotton silk, the Moonbeam Kurta features a regular, long silhouette with a split neckline and three-quarter raglan sleeves. Gold foil dots and multicolour rose and anar butti embroidery add colour and texture, while red thread faggoting and antique gold twisted loop lace bring considered festive details. Silver sequins around the neckline add a small flash of light.
  • The matching Stellar Pants are cut in organic cotton voile with an easy A-line silhouette and room through the leg. Rainbow sequin pintucks finish the bottom hem panel, with a small red heart embroidery above and red thread faggoting adding definition.
  • Wear the set for festive evenings and celebrations, or style the pieces separately for a more understated look.

products.title: The Basic Mid Length Kurta Set
products.body_html:
• Firefly, our muse for the festive season, takes inspiration from the delicate, fleeting glow of fireflies that appear at dusk and make the night feel a little more magical. The Long Length Kurta and Serene Pants bring that feeling to berry pink, pairing a striped viscose silk kurta with relaxed Silk Blend pants.
  • Cut in viscose silk, the Mid Length Kurta features an elongated silhouette with a mandarin collar and full cuffed sleeves. Silver Lampi gota traces the underplacket, while a jali flower sequin sits at the centre back. Grey shell buttons finish the placket and cuffs.
  • The matching Serene Pants are cut in Silk Blend with a relaxed fit and room through the leg for easy movement. Chevron stripes create a rhythmic pattern, with mirrored pockets and centre seams adding a considered finish. A gold anar with cobalt blue beaded embroidery adds a crafted flash of colour at the front pocket.
  • Wear the set for light festive lunches, family gatherings and relaxed celebrations, or style the pieces separately.

products.title: The Nebula Kurta Set
products.body_html:
• Firefly, our muse for the festive season, takes inspiration from the delicate, fleeting glow of fireflies that appear at dusk and make the night feel a little more magical. The Nebula Kurta Set brings that feeling to rich purple, pairing an embroidered cotton silk kurta with streamlined Silk Blend pants.
  • Cut in cotton silk, the Nebula Kurta features a long silhouette with a V-neckline and three-quarter sleeves. All-over floral embroidery adds soft texture, while side tie-ups with cotton voile ties let you adjust the silhouette. Gota detailing at the sleeve hem adds a subtle festive glint.
  • The matching Darjeeling Pants are cut in Silk Blend with a narrow fit for a clean, streamlined shape. A red and gold embroidered tulip at the hem adds a considered pop of colour, while side pockets and a concealed zip keep the finish practical.
  • Wear the set together for festive gatherings, or style the pieces separately with your existing wardrobe.

products.title: The Cascade Kurta Set
products.body_html:
• Firefly, our muse for the festive season, takes inspiration from the delicate, fleeting glow of fireflies that appear at dusk and make the night feel a little more magical. The Cascade Kurta Set brings that feeling to an olive green palette, pairing a floral cotton silk kurta with printed organic cotton voile pyjamas.
  • The Cascade Kurta is cut in cotton silk with a regular, long silhouette, V-neckline and half sleeves. An all-over Guldasta print is layered with sequin flower lifting across the front, back and sleeves, while metallic tissue Kandy stripe binding adds flashes of red and silver at the neckline and sleeve piping.
  • The matching Basic Pyjamas are made in organic cotton voile with an easy regular fit, elasticated waistband, side pockets and hanger loops. An olive green ditsy chintz print is finished with silver sequin highlights along the hem and antique silver gota for a subtle festive shine.
  • Wear the set together for festive gatherings, or style the pieces separately with your existing wardrobe.

products.title: The Golden Hour Shirt Set
products.body_html:
• Firefly, our muse for the festive season, takes inspiration from the delicate, fleeting glow of fireflies that appear at dusk and make the night feel a little more magical. The Golden Hour Shirt Set catches that feeling in luminous gold metallic tissue, pairing a long A-line shirt with fluid, easy pants.
  • Made in metallic tissue, the Golden Hour Shirt features a relaxed camp collar, three-quarter flare sleeves and an elongated A-line silhouette that moves away from a conventional shirt shape. Tiny stone bug embroidery appears around the front notch collar and across the back, adding a delicate natural motif to the shimmering surface.
  • The matching Charisma Pants are cut in metallic tissue with an easy A-line fit and elasticated waistband, falling fluidly through the leg. The solid gold ground keeps the silhouette clean, letting the luminous fabric and considered embroidered details take centre stage.
  • Wear set for celebrations, dinners and days that call for something a little more dressed up, or style the two pieces separately with pieces already in your wardrobe.

products.title: The Galaxy Kurta Set
products.body_html:
• Firefly, our muse for the festive season, takes inspiration from the delicate, fleeting glow of fireflies that appear at dusk and make the night feel a little more magical. The Galaxy Kurta Set brings that evening glow to red and berry stripes, pairing a cotton silk kurta with relaxed A-line pyjamas in organic cotton voile.
  • Cut in cotton silk, the Galaxy Kurta features a regular fit with a round neckline and keyhole slit, scattered with delicate gold foil tulip buttas that catch the light with every movement. Three-quarter sleeves are finished with twisted loop gold lace and subtle gold zari detailing, while fine gold gota traces the neckline and a matching gota dori adds texture to the keyhole.
  • The matching Basic Pyjamas are crafted in organic cotton voile with an easy A-line silhouette, elasticated waistband, side pockets and hanger loops. Red and berry Kandy stripes bring a graphic note to the soft voile, finished with a sequin zari flower patch at the bottom corner of one leg.
  • Wear set for celebrations, dinners and days that call for something a little more dressed up, or style the two pieces separately with pieces already in your wardrobe.

products.title: The Hala Tunic Set
products.body_html:
• Firefly, our muse for the festive season, takes inspiration from the delicate, fleeting glow of fireflies that appear at dusk and make the night feel a little more magical. The Hala Tunic Set brings that feeling to a fresh chartreuse palette, pairing an easy mid-length tunic with relaxed A-line pyjamas and small crafted details that reveal themselves as you move.
  • Crafted in cotton silk, the Hala Tunic features a loose mid-length silhouette with a shirt collar, three-quarter kaftan sleeves and a neat baby hem. A delicate zardozi flower sits at the centre back, placed within a moon patch, while ivory shell buttons add a simple, tactile finish along the placket, collar and cuffs.
  • The matching Basic Pyjamas are cut in Cotton Silk with an easy A-line shape, finished with an elasticated waistband, side pockets and hanger loops. A small Gota Chakri flower embroidery at the bottom corner of one leg brings a considered crafted detail to the clean silhouette.
  • Wear the Hala Tunic Set for celebrations, dinners and days that call for something a little more dressed up, or style the Hala Tunic and Basic Pyjamas separately with pieces already in your wardrobe.

products.title: The Midnight Club Kurta Set
products.body_html:
• Firefly, our muse for the festive season, takes inspiration from the delicate, fleeting glow of fireflies that appear at dusk and make the night feel a little more magical. The Midnight Club Kurta Set brings that feeling to a playful mix of green and blue Kandy stripes, pairing a long cotton silk kurta with narrow-fit organic cotton voile pants.
  • Cut in cotton silk, the Midnight Club Kurta features an A-line silhouette with a long length, V-neckline and three-quarter regular sleeves. The stripe and foil pattern is carefully matched at the centre front and back, while twisted loop gold lace, check piping and a red three-beaded detail bring considered festive touches to the neckline and sleeves.
  • The Wander Pants are cut in a silk blend, these regular-fitting pants have an easy silhouette designed to fall comfortably through the leg.The solid aqua ground keeps the look fresh and versatile, making it easy to pair with printed or embellished festive separates.
  • Wear set for celebrations, dinners and days that call for something a little more dressed up, or style the two pieces separately with pieces already in your wardrobe.

products.title: Nimbu & Mirchi Candle Holder Set of 2
products.body_html:
• The nimbu and mirchi, the lemon and chilli traditionally strung at doorways for luck, become a pair of candle holders.
  • Iron and aluminium with leaves in matte gold, and enamel fruit: deep red chillies on the shorter stand and yellow lemons on the taller.
  • A taper candle sits in the cup at the top of each stem.
  • Dimensions: Mirchi Candle Holder - 10 x 10 x 18 Cm, Nimbu Candle Holder - 10 x 10 x 22 Cm

products.title: Taal Gift Set - Incense holder, diya and incense sticks
products.body_html:
• Taal, for the leaf, inspires two pieces cut in its shape: a diya with four cupped petals on a stem, and a long feathered leaf that holds an incense stick.
  • Iron, brass and aluminium in matte gold, with enamel on the diya.
  • Incense sticks come in the box, in Nerola or Madurai Red.
  • Dimensions: Incense Holder - 14 x 4 x 2 Cm, Diya - 16 x 8 x 2.5 Cm

products.title: Vanika Gift Set
products.body_html:
• Four cotton voile napkins printed with palms across a green and white stripe, paired with four glass napkin rings blown as open flowers.
  • Each ring is a different bloom: blue, white, red and violet, in glossy glass with green leaves.
  • Cloth and glass come together in one box, making it more than a napkin set.
  • Dimensions: Napkin Ring - 5 x 7 x 6 Cm, Napkin - 46 x 46 Cm

products.title: Baby Ele Gift Set
products.body_html:
• A first dinner set: a plate, katori, tumbler and spoon, each carrying a small elephant.
  • Steel and brass in a matte silver finish, with a ribbed base on the tumbler.
  • Shaped around the thali a child grows up eating from.
  • Dimensions: Plate - 17 x 17 x 2 Cm, Tumbler - 6 x 6 x 8 Cm, Katori - 7 x 7 x 4 Cm, Spoon - 12 x 3 Cm

products.title: Twilight Gift Set
products.body_html:
• Charcoal and ivory across twelve pieces: stars, stripes, a chevron and a scallop, with a small deer running through them.
  • Four espresso mugs and four tea plates in stoneware, plus four velvet coasters trimmed in gold, one carrying a sun and one a palm.
  • Put together for coffee at the end of an evening rather than the first cup of the day.
  • Dimensions: Cup - 8 x 8 x 7 Cm, Tea Plate - 13 x 13 x 2 Cm, Coaster - 10.16 x 0.5 Cm

products.title: Hornbill Gift Set
products.body_html:
• Eight pieces of stoneware in two prints: a palm in full spread with pink blossom at its foot, and a green check covering the whole face.
  • Four dessert plates and four straight mugs, boxed together.
  • The prints alternate through the set, so the four plates are never all the same.
  • Dimensions: Dessert Plate - 16 x 16 x 2 Cm, Mug - 8 x 8 x 9 Cm

products.title: Kaveri Placemat - Set of 2
products.body_html:
• Woven in the banu technique with palmyra palm fibres, the Kaveri Placemat brings texture and craft to the everyday table. Finished with beaded lace edging, it adds a festive lift to a set of place settings.
  • The natural palm fibre base grounds the table while the beaded edge catches light — a small detail that changes the whole setting.
  • Pair it with the Kaveri Runner for a fully coordinated festive table.

products.title: Madhu Napkin - Set of 4
products.body_html:
• Four napkins in cotton voile, printed with sprays of white blossom and leaves.
  • A knife edge finished with zari, tracing a fine line of gold around each one.
  • Voile folds small and drapes easily rather than standing stiffly.

products.title: Kingfisher Bloom Cushion Cover
products.body_html:
• Kingfishers mid-flight across a deep green base, with blossom, palms and a leopard among them.
  • Printed on PET with a knife edge, front and back in the same cloth.
  • Rectangular, so the birds run the length of the cover.

products.title: Reesha Cushion Cover
products.body_html:
• A pink base with a white blossom spray, a small bird and a leopard at the foot of the stem.
  • Printed on PET with a knife edge, front and back in the same cloth.
  • A rectangular cover shaped to sit neatly at the small of the back.

products.title: Malti Cushion Cover
products.body_html:
• A charcoal base scattered with pink blossom, with a leopard among the leaves.
  • Mashru front and back, finished with solid piping around the edge.
  • Printed so the smaller details stay fine: a dragonfly, a stem and a turned leaf.

products.title: Buransh Cushion Cover
products.body_html:
• The buransh, the red rhododendron of the Nilgarian hills, printed in full flower across a cream base.
  • Mashru front and back, finished with solid piping around the edge.
  • Printed rather than embroidered, keeping the botanical drawing fine.

products.title: Kaveri Candle With base
products.body_html:
• A glass jar candle in gold, printed with palms and a scatter of stars, set into an iron stand on three legs.
  • Scented with Madurai.
  • The stand lifts the jar clear of the table, letting the light sit a little higher in the room.

products.title: Kaveri Candle Stand - Set of 2 with taper candles
products.body_html:
• Two candle stands blown in the shape of flowers on stems: green stalks, round feet and petals opening around each cup.
  • Glossy glass, with pink petals over green.
  • Taper candles come with the set.

products.title: Kaveri Votives - Set of 2
products.body_html:
• Two votives shaped like open flowers, each finished with a ring at the side for carrying.
  • Iron in a matte gold finish.
  • Inspired by the old chamberstick, but made for a tealight rather than a taper.

products.title: Flight Origami
products.body_html:
• A paper aeroplane, folded in solid brass.
  • Matte gold, with creases sharp enough to read as paper from across the room.
  • Weighty for its size, making it a paperweight first and ornament second.

products.title: Dhaara Quarter Plate - Set of 2
products.body_html:
• Two quarter plates in the Dhaara ripple, one gold and one silver.
  • Ceramic with a matte finish, so the metallic reads as colour rather than polish.
  • The rings radiate from the centre, drawing the eye towards whatever is served on top.

products.title: Dhaara Fruit Bowl
products.body_html:
• A wide bowl with a fluted edge that folds like a flower, with the Dhaara ripple pressed into the base.
  • Ceramic in a matte gold finish.
  • Deep at the centre and open at the rim, keeping fruit visible rather than buried.

products.title: Dhaara Platter Set
products.body_html:
• An oval platter with the Dhaara ripple running its length, with a small dip bowl and spoon tucked inside.
  • Ceramic in a matte gold finish, with the rings catching light along the curve.
  • Three pieces designed to arrive together and be used together.
  • Dimensions: Platter - 36 x 20 x 3.1 Cm, Nut Bowl - 10.5 x 4.5 Cm, Spoon - 11 x 2.7 Cm

products.title: Dhaara Nut Bowl with Spoon - Set of 2
products.body_html:
• Dhaara takes its pattern from moving water: rings rippling out from the centre of each bowl.
  • Two small ceramic bowls in a matte finish, one gold and one silver, each with a matching spoon.
  • Ceramic rather than metal, so the finish comes without the extra weight.
  • Dimensions: Nut Bowl - 10.5 x 10.5 x 4.5 Cm, Spoon - 11 x 2.7 Cm

products.title: Hive Napkin Holder
products.body_html:
• A block of white marble with two brass bees rising from it on fine stalks.
  • Napkins sit neatly between the stalks, held upright by the weight of the stone.
  • Brass has a matte finish, keeping the bees as considered detail rather than shine.

products.title: Chand Tiffin Box
products.body_html:
• Chand, for the moon, gives this tiffin its domed lid and small finial.
  • Stainless steel in a matte gold finish, topped with a rattan-wrapped handle that arcs over the lid.
  • Stacking bowls fit inside, so a whole meal travels neatly in one hand.

products.title: Bloom Round Tray
products.body_html:
• A round tray carrying a botanical study of dragonflies, wildflowers in yellow, red and blue, and grasses across a cream base.
  • Green around the edge, with a raised lip that keeps glasses in place.
  • MDF with a glossy lacquer finish, keeping the print crisp and making spills easy to wipe away.

products.title: Tango Kaftan - Metallic Tissue Free Size
products.body_html:
• The Tango Kaftan brings that spirit to silver metallic tissue.
  • Cut free-size, it has a band collar, cap sleeves and a front that falls open over trousers.
  • Three stone-embroidered motifs sit at the right shoulder, and a narrow blue pleated trim runs along the back neck.
  • A box pleat opens down the back, and hand tacking finishes the concealed placket. Made for festive evenings, dinners and celebrations.

products.title: Tango Kaftan - Metallic Tissue Free Size
products.body_html:
• The Tango Kaftan brings that spirit to molten gold metallic tissue.
  • Cut free-size, it has a band collar, cap sleeves and a front that falls open over trousers.
  • A red berry, a teal flower and a blue bug are embroidered in stones at the right shoulder, and a narrow red pleated trim runs along the back neck.
  • A box pleat opens down the back, and hand tacking finishes the concealed placket. Made for festive evenings, dinners and celebrations.

products.title: Muris Sling - Red & Purple
products.body_html:
• A sling built on red and purple stripes alternating across dotted mashru.
  • Antique brass hardware anchors a gold gota star at the centre, with an embroidered handle beaded in zari thread.
  • A magnetic closure keeps things simple, no clasp to fight with on the way out the door.

products.title: Fold Over Clutch - Gold & Silver
products.body_html:
• A clutch that folds to show two faces, light gold on one side, silver foiled canvas on the other.
  • Antique brass hardware frames a zipper in green tape, pulled open by a green glass bead tassel.
  • The two sides mean it reads differently depending on which way you're holding it.
  • Fold it flat for evening, or unfold it when you need the extra room.

products.title: Martini Clutch - Black Embroidered
products.body_html:
• A structured clutch built on a metal frame, striped in black and ivory.
  • The surface is studded with stone embroidery worked into bugs and bees.
  • Antique brass hardware finishes the frame, with a chain handle for when you want it worn, not carried.

products.title: Flower Coin Pouch - Black & Red
products.body_html:
• A coin pouch cut into the shape of a flower, black and white mini-check leather with a red leather centre.
  • A concealed nylon zip pocket sits at the back, out of sight until you need it.
  • Finished with a black and white check leather cord and a circular doglock ring, so it clips onto a bag rather than sitting loose.

products.title: Leopard Pocket Squares - Pure Silk
products.body_html:
• Two pocket squares in pure silk, printed in a leopard and hornbill motif.
  • Finished with a baby roll hemline, kept simple so the forest inspired prints do the work.
  • Perfectly sized to bring the forest to a breast pocket or a bag strap.

products.title: Firefly Pocket Squares - Pure silk
products.body_html:
• A set of two pocket squares in pure silk, one in aqua, one in navy, both printed abstract.
  • Finished with a baby roll hemline, kept simple so the print carries the design.
  • Perfectly sized for a breast pocket or a bag strap.

products.title: Jashn Scarf - Berry & Silver
products.body_html:
• A compact cotton silk scarf with ditsy all-over silver foil flowers on a berry base.
  • Finished with piping in black and white checks running across the scarf.
  • Woven in chanderi, sized to wear at the neck or tied onto a bag.

products.title: Bouquet Scarf - Pure Silk
products.body_html:
• A pure silk scarf named for the guldasta, or bouquet, printed all over in garden florals.
  • Finished with a baby roll hemline, tassels at opposite corners, and mother-of-pearl buttons.
  • Woven in 100% silk.

products.title: Firefly Scarf - Grey & Gold
products.body_html:
• A Linen with Zari scarf in a grey and gold drawing on the collection's kalamkari-inspired garden motifs.
  • Finished with a red star embroidered icon on one corner.
  • Woven in alternate zari and linen stripes.

products.title: Hana Spec Case - Green
products.body_html:
• A specs case sized to slip into a bag, printed in a leopard motif.
  • Kept to green, it's finished with a antique brass metal frame for a secure closure.
  • Small and specific, built to protect a pair of glasses without adding bulk.

products.title: Sling Clutch - Red Embroidered
products.body_html:
• A sling clutch printed on both sides, a bird perched on a flower on one, a peony on the other.
  • Sequins and beads sit over the print, lifting it rather than covering it up.
  • Antique brass hardware finishes the edges, with piping detail carried through to the lining.

products.title: Bloom Bag - Floral Embroidered
products.body_html:
• A shoulder bag with floral embroidery, worked with beads and sequins.
  • The strap plays both sides, embroidered on one, red and white check print on the other.
  • Antique brass hardware and a red nylon zip close it up, with a heart-shaped fabric puller finishing the pull.

products.title: Tassel Shoulder Duster - Silver
products.body_html:
• A shoulder-duster earring, with beaded strands falling well past the earlobe.
  • Handcrafted in brass and finished in a silver-tone plating throughout.
  • Built for the earring to be the only jewellery in the room.

products.title: Tassel Shoulder Duster - Gold
products.body_html:
• A shoulder-duster earring, with beaded strands falling well past the earlobe.
  • Handcrafted in brass and 18k gold-plated throughout.
  • Built for the earring to be the only jewellery in the room.

products.title: Chaandphool Cuff - Gold
products.body_html:
• An open cuff that ends in two floral, crescent moons, facing each other.
  • Handcrafted in brass with 18ct gold plating, its slim band tapers into the chaand at each tip.
  • A simple everyday bangle that easily slips into glam mode if it sits at the bottom of a stack.

products.title: Dhaara Cuff - Gold
products.body_html:
• A cuff that moves like water, and lends its name to the aptly named: dhaara cuff.
  • Handcrafted in brass with 18ct gold plating, its wavy band twists rather than sitting flat.
  • Granulated detailing marks each end, a small anchor on an otherwise fluid form.
  • Stack three together, or simply pair with a single Clover cuff for a mixed set.

products.title: Clover Cuff - Gold
products.body_html:
• A cuff centred on a single clover, worked in high relief.
  • Handcrafted in brass with 18ct gold plating, its rounded band sits flush against the wrist.
  • The clover is the only detail it needs.
  • Wear it alone or stack it with the Dhaara cuff for company.

products.title: Jalpari Cufflinks - Gold
products.body_html:
• A cufflink built around the jalpari, a fish rendered in a single curved line.
  • Handcrafted in brass and 18k gold-plated, kept smooth rather than textured.
  • A quieter cufflink than the Appu or Roar, more line than detail.

products.title: Bindu Pearl Necklace - Gold
products.body_html:
• A double pearl necklace punctuated and held together by alternating stars and moons.
  • Handcrafted in brass with 18ct gold plating, its seed pearls run in two fine strands.
  • Layer it under a collar or wear it alone against plain fabric.

products.title: Nebra Lapel Pin - Gold
products.body_html:
• A lapel pin topped with a round, hammered gold medallion.
  • Handcrafted in brass and 18k gold-plated, set with a single zircon stone.
  • Named for the Nebra sky disc, it brings a small piece of celestial detail to a plain lapel.

products.title: Roar Cufflinks - Gold
products.body_html:
• A cufflink for anyone who'd rather their cuffs do the roaring.
  • Handcrafted in brass with 18ct gold plating, the tiger finished with a stone eye and etched stripes.
  • Mid-stride and mid-snarl, it's more character than a simple accessory. Pairs well with a plain cuff.

products.title: Drangonfly Bracelet - Gold
products.body_html:
• A stretch bracelet in faceted metal beads, finished with a dragonfly charm.
  • Handcrafted in brass and 18k gold-plated, the charm dangling free at the clasp.
  • The dragonfly is the most detailed of the three charms, with etched wings.

products.title: Appu Cufflinks - Gold
products.body_html:
• Cufflinks shaped like seated elephants, named appu after the elephant that inspired them.
  • Handcrafted in brass with 18ct gold plating, textured to bring out the folds of the ears and trunk.
  • Small enough for a cuff, flamboyant enough to be the only accessory needed.
  • For the shirt that could use a little personality at the wrist.

products.title: Sitara Bracelet - Gold
products.body_html:
• A stretch bracelet in faceted dark pink jade beads, finished with a sitara, or star, charm.
  • Handcrafted in brass and 18k gold-plated, the charm dangling free at the clasp.
  • Part of a set of three, each one carrying its own small charm.

products.title: Jalpari Bracelet - Gold
products.body_html:
• A stretch bracelet in faceted sodalite beads, finished with a fish charm.
  • Handcrafted in brass and 18k gold-plated, the charm floating freely.
  • Jalpari drawing on the fish motifs running through our year long river stories.

products.title: Phool Jaal Necklace - Gold
products.body_html:
• The phool jaal lattice, scaled up into a bib necklace, to look like a flower net, as is the inspiration for its name.
  • Gold-plated brass, its flowers cascade down the collarbone.
  • Built for the evening a plain neckline needs a little oomph.

products.title: Chandphool Choker - Gold
products.body_html:
• A choker built from two recurring motifs: the chaand and the phool.
  • Handcrafted in brass and 18k gold-plated, its sodalite discs sit on a fine, scarlet cord.
  • Moons and flowers alternate round the neck and it ties at the back, so length adjusts to however close you prefer it.

products.title: Appu Necklace - Gold
products.body_html:
• An elephant that doubles as a locket. Gold-plated brass, this rectangular pendant opens on a hinge.
  • The elephant sits in relief harking back to its inspiration, the original Appu mascot.
  • Wear it long on a long chain, and forget it's a locket until you need to hide a treasure.

products.title: Nandi Necklace - Gold
products.body_html:
• Nandi, rendered here in miniature plated in gold and handcrafted in brass.
  • The bull's belly carries a wire-caged crystal sphere.
  • A deliberate pairing: one solid, another that catches light through glass.

products.title: Kari Necklace - Gold
products.body_html:
• A necklace built on a single large oval link, with a smaller stone pendant sitting beside it.
  • Handcrafted in brass and 18k gold-plated, set with glass and strawberry quartz.
  • The oval does the visual work, the pendant is the quiet detail beside it.

products.title: Gul Baag Necklace - Gold
products.body_html:
• The Gul Baag motif brought down to sit at the collarbone.
  • Handcrafted in brass with a gold plating on a fine chain, its cross pendant is set with stone florals.
  • Fish curl outward on either side, swimming in the garden.
  • Wear it close to the throat or let the chain fall long, either way it holds its own.

products.title: Sage Necklace - Gold
products.body_html:
• A necklace shaped like a kamandala, the pot sage Agastya once carried in search of a place to create a river.
  • Handcrafted in brass and 18k gold-plated on a beaded chain, set with glass at the centre to stand in for the water it once held.
  • As the story goes, that water was the goddess Kaveri herself, released when the pot was tipped over at Talakaveri.

products.title: Moon Flower Earrings - Gold
products.body_html:
• A chandelier earring with a floral gold frame, set with red stones down its length.
  • Handcrafted in brass and 18k gold-plated, finished in glass for a strong pop of red.
  • Ends in a plain gold hoop, so the drama sits at the top and tapers down.

products.title: Kolam Danglers - Gold
products.body_html:
• A dangling earring built on a repeating wire loop, with pink and green stones set into each turn.
  • Handcrafted in brass and 18k gold-plated, finished with glass in a two-colour pattern.
  • Inspired by the kolam's looping, symmetrical lines drawn in coarse rice flour each morning.

products.title: Gul Baag Earring - Gold
products.body_html:
• A gold-plated cross-shaped earring built like a garden in miniature, gul baag translating loosely to flower garden.
  • Its arms with fish curled around them end in stone-set flowers.
  • Each arm is punctuated with its own bloom, so the earring looks like a dangling bouquet.

products.title: Gulbahar Earrings - Gold
products.body_html:
• A dangling earring where fine beaded fringe falls from a domed top.
  • Handcrafted in brass and 18k gold-plated, finished with delicate metal beading throughout.
  • Gulbahar meaning spring flower, it's built to move like petals catching a breeze.

products.title: Kaveri Jhumka - Gold
products.body_html:
• Our take on the traditional dome jhumka, updated with nico hearts worked into the links the beads hang from.
  • Handcrafted in brass and 18k gold-plated, topped with a single red stone in glass.
  • Named for the Kaveri, the river said to have begun when a sage's pot of water was tipped over at Talakaveri.

products.title: Chandphool Earrings - Gold
products.body_html:
• A short drop earring pairing a small floral-crescent moon with an oval magenta stone.
  • Handcrafted in brass and 18k gold-plated, set with glass for a rich, saturated colour.
  • Pared down compared to the rest of the Chaandphool family, but still unmistakably part of it.

products.title: Dessert Rose Drops - Gold
products.body_html:
• A drop earring flowing from a gold flower to a green stone, and a magenta stone below it.
  • Handcrafted in brass and 18k gold-plated, set with ruby jade and glass.
  • Each tier is a different material, so the earring displays a small, layered composition.

products.title: Nadi Earrings - Pink & Green
products.body_html:
• A rectangular drop earring set with two glass stones, pink above and green below.
  • Handcrafted in brass and 18k gold-plated, finished with a plain gold hook.
  • Simple, colour-blocked, and built to survive outfit changes.

products.title: Phool Jaal Earring - Gold
products.body_html:
• A lattice of flowers that falls like a net, jaal meaning exactly that, hence lending it its name: Phool Jaal.
  • Handcrafted in brass, plated in gold and finished with pearl drops, adding a delicate detail.
  • Each flower link is cut from sheet metal, joined so the whole thing moves as one.

products.title: Chandphool Sui Dhaga Earrings - Gold
products.body_html:

• The Surya Rakhi Set brings together two keepsakes that celebrate warmth, optimism and new beginnings.
  • It includes our Surya Rakhi and matching Sun Charmlet, both crafted in brass and finished with 18 carat pure gold plating.
  • The rakhi is tied with a traditional mauli thread, while the Sun Charmlet is designed to be worn on your Nicobar Charm Bracelet long after the celebrations are over.
  • Beautifully presented in a ready-to-ship giftable envelope with a card inside to hold your thoughts even closer.
  • Thoughtful together, timeless forever, it's a gift made to be cherished long after the day is over.

products.title: Moonlight Tea Set
products.body_html:
• For moonlit brews or ones in the morning sun the Moonlight Tea Set is a fitting choice featuring a set of 4 Chand Espresso Mugs and a set of 4 Mandovi Tea Plates.
  • Love monochrome? Charm your guests with black and white Chand Espresso Mugs.
  • With prints inspired by the Konkan coast, the Mandovi Tea Plates will prop up breakfatst, high tea, and everything in between.

products.title: Serenity Set
products.body_html:
• Grab a moment of calm with the Serenity Set with the Chand Espresso Mug (Set of 4), Periyar Tea Plates (Set of 4) and Mahi Cookie Tray & Tong.
  • Love monochrome? Charm your guests with black and white espresso mugs with motifs inspired from our travels.
  • Printed with motifs inspired by the Malabar Coast, this set of tea plates are crafted in smooth stoneware
  • Crafted in smooth stoneware, our cookie tray features motifs inspired by the flora and fauna found along India's vast coast, plus a pair of tongs with brass finish.

products.title: Chand Coffee Set
products.body_html:
• Elevate your mornign coffee with the Chand Coffee Set with the Chand Espresso Mug (Set of 4). Cheetah Tea Plates (Set of 4) and Mahi Cookie Tray & Tong.
  • Love monochrome? Charm your guests with black and white espresso mugs with motifs inspired from our travels.
  • Take tea-time up a notch with bold and bright tea plates, crafted in sturdy stonewareThe eye-catching cheetah prints are a must have!
  • Crafted in smooth stoneware, our cookie tray features motifs inspired by the flora and fauna found along India's vast coast, plus a pair of tongs with brass finish.

products.title: Nerola Gift Set
products.body_html:
• Built around a single fragrance carried across four formats, the Nerola Gift Set lets one scent follow you through the house. A jar candle for lighting, an oil vial for small spaces, a reed diffuser for constant fragrance and a room spray for instant effect — each piece plays a different role in scenting a home.
  • The soft, floral notes of Nerola make it a versatile gifting fragrance — festive without being heavy-handed.
  • Gift it whole as a complete fragrance wardrobe for the home, or let the recipient choose their favourite format to start with.
    • Dimensions: Jar Candle - 7 x 8 Cm, Oil Vial - 30 ML, Room Spray - 100 ML, Reed Diffuser - 100 ML

products.title: Avi Bar Gift Set
products.body_html:
• Designed for the host who takes the first round seriously, the Avi Bar Gift Set pairs a stainless steel cocktail shaker with a matching set of two margarita glasses. Finished in a matte decal, the set brings a clean, contemporary look to any home bar.
  • It's built for gifting, practical, good-looking, and ready to use the moment it's unwrapped.
  • Gift it on its own, or pair it with a bottle of the recipient's go-to spirit for a complete bar-night gift.
    • Dimensions: Cocktail Shaker - 9 x 9 x 22 Cm, Margarita Cup - 14 x 14 x 12 Cm

products.title: Mithai Candle Gift Set
products.body_html:
• Shaped like the sweets exchanged every Diwali, the Mithai Gift Set reimagines a festive tradition in soy wax. Each candle in the set of 7 is finished in matte, multi-coloured wax that mimics a plate of mithai, a gift that plays along with the season's oldest ritual.
  • It works as a standalone gift or as part of a larger festive hamper, adding both light and a sense of play to the giving.
  • Style it on a tray or thali for a tablescape that doubles as decor before it's ever lit.

products.title: Kaveri Table Cover
products.body_html:
• Woven in the banu technique with palmyra palm fibres, the Kaveri Placemat brings texture and craft to the everyday table. Finished with beaded lace edging, it adds a festive lift to a set of place settings.
  • The natural palm fibre base grounds the table while the beaded edge catches light — a small detail that changes the whole setting.
  • Pair it with the Kaveri Runner for a fully coordinated festive table.

products.title: Kaveri Runner
products.body_html:
• Inspired by the textures of the festive table, the Kaveri Runner brings a handcrafted warmth to everyday dining. Woven in hessian jute with hand embroidery and a golden fringe lace edge, it turns a simple table into an occasion.
  • The multi colourway and fringed edge make it a natural fit for festive spreads, catching light without ever feeling too formal.
  • Style it as the base layer for your table setting, let the plates, glasses and centrepiece build on top of it.

products.title: Kinaara Cushion Cover
products.body_html:
• Inspired by the lush greenery and flowering banks of the River Krishna, the Kinaara Cushion Cover brings a fresh, colourful note to festive spaces. The green chanderi front is detailed with delicate embroidery and finished with playful pink fringes, while the striped reverse adds another layer of pattern.
  • The mix of woven texture, embroidery and contrast colour gives the cushion a relaxed, collected character.
  • Layer it with deeper greens, pinks and warm neutrals on a sofa, bed or occasional chair.

products.title: Midas Cushion Cover
products.body_html:
• Inspired by the warm, sunlit landscapes surrounding the River Krishna, the Midas Cushion Cover pairs rich mustard Chanderi with delicate embroidery for a festive accent with understated warmth. The front is finished with a subtle embroidered detail, while the reverse features a fine foil stripe for a hint of shimmer.
  • Zari Kandy piping frames the cushion, adding a refined glint around its edges without overpowering the design.
  • Pair it with earthy tones, jewel colours or other textured cushions for a warm, layered setting.

products.title: Buransh Bloom Cushion Cover
products.body_html:
• Inspired by the vivid blooms and foliage of the landscapes around the River Krishna, the Buransh Bloom Cushion Cover brings botanical colour indoors. Its green cotton moss base features a richly detailed floral print layered with embroidery in gold, creating depth and dimension across the surface.
  • The simple knife-edge finish keeps the intricate botanical design at the centre, while the generous square shape makes it easy to style as a statement cushion.
  • Pair it with solid velvet cushions or layer it with other botanical patterns for a more abundant festive setting.

products.title: Palm Shimmer Cushion Cover - Yellow
products.body_html:
• Inspired by the graceful palms and tropical foliage found along the River Krishna, the Palm Shimmer Cushion Cover brings a warm, luminous note to festive spaces. Crafted in mustard cotton velvet, its surface is finished with delicate palm-inspired embroidery that catches the light beautifully.
  • The plush velvet gives the cushion a rich, tactile quality, while the clean piping finish keeps the look considered.
  • Pair it with deeper greens, warm neutrals or jewel tones to create a layered festive setting.

products.title: Palm Shimmer Cushion Cover - Pink
products.body_html:
• Inspired by the graceful palms and tropical foliage found along the River Krishna, the Palm Shimmer Cushion Cover brings a luminous take on botanical forms. Crafted in plush pink cotton velvet, its surface is detailed with delicate embroidery that catches the light with every change in angle.
  • The rich velvet base gives the cushion depth and softness, while the clean piping finish keeps the silhouette refined.
  • Style it with jewel tones for a festive arrangement or let it stand out against neutral upholstery.

products.title: Tassel Bolster Cover
products.body_html:
• Inspired by the relaxed beauty of the River Krishna and its surrounding landscapes, the Tassel Bolster brings colour, texture and an easy sense of movement to the home. Woven in Chanderi with a self-woven texture, it is finished with playful tassels and ties along the edges.
  • The elongated shape works beautifully across sofas, daybeds and beds, adding a soft layer of colour without feeling too formal.
  • Style it on its own or layer it with cushions in complementary tones for a relaxed festive setting.

products.title: GIlded Palm Cushion Cover
products.body_html:
• Inspired by the palms and abundant foliage found along the banks of the River Krishna, the Gilded Palm Cushion Cover brings the landscape indoors through intricate embroidery. A soft cotton flex front is detailed with palm-inspired motifs in grey and gold, while the reverse is finished in screen printed cotton duck.
  • A golden fringe lace border frames the cushion, adding a subtle festive glimmer to its organic design.
  • Pair it with solid cushions or layer it with other botanical patterns to bring warmth and character to a sofa, armchair or bed.

products.title: Madhu Cushion Cover
products.body_html:
• Inspired by the delicate flora found along the banks of the River Krishna, the Madhu Cushion Cover brings a soft, intricate detail to festive spaces. Crafted in cotton flex, its ivory surface is finished with delicate lace embroidery and framed by a fine golden flat-lace border.
  • The understated palette and fine detailing give it a quiet elegance that works across a range of interiors.
  • Layer it with textured cushions or pair it with richer festive tones for a considered arrangement.

products.title: Bumble Bee Cushion Cover
products.body_html:
• Inspired by the small wonders of nature around the River Krishna, the Bumble Bee Cushion Cover brings a playful touch to festive interiors. Embroidered in ivory and gold on cotton flex, its delicate motif is framed by a twisted lace edge for added texture.
  • The soft ivory base keeps the design easy to layer, while the gold detailing brings just enough shimmer for festive settings.
  • Style it with botanical cushions or keep it simple alongside neutral linens for a quieter look.

products.title: Smriti Votive - Set of 2
products.body_html:
• Inspired by the quiet beauty of natural forms found along the banks of the River Krishna, the Smriti Votives bring an understated sculptural touch to festive spaces. Crafted in iron with a soft matte gold finish, designed to hold the warm glow of votive candles. Complete with small dragonflies and stars that add charecter to the pieces.
  • Their compact size makes them easy to style across a dining table, console or shelf, bringing warmth and a gentle glow without overwhelming the space.
  • Use the pair together for a considered arrangement or place them in different corners of the room for pockets of candlelight.

products.title: Jasmine Bloom Tealight Holder
products.body_html:
• Inspired by the delicate blooms found along the banks of the River Krishna, the Jasmine Bloom Tealight Holder brings a sculptural interpretation of nature to festive spaces. The jasmine bloom takes an immortal form, adding a gildedd touch to spaces.
  • Crafted in iron and aluminium, its open floral form is finished in soft matte gold, creating an elegant frame for the warm glow of a tealight.
  • Its elongated silhouette makes a graceful addition to dining tables, consoles and sideboards, adding height and a gentle play of light to festive settings.
  • Style it as a standalone accent or pair it with candles and floral arrangements to create a layered festive display.

products.title: Kandy Diffuser
products.body_html:
• Inspired by the rich colours and organic forms of the Indian landscape, the Kandy Diffuser brings fragrance and decoration together in one considered piece. Crafted in stainless steel and glass, with a gold finish and rattan-wrapped handle, it’s designed to infuse your space with scent and subtle warmth.
  • Its compact form makes it easy to place on a console, bedside table or shelf, while the decorative finish gives it presence even when not in use.
  • Made for festive homes and slow evenings, it brings a gentle layer of fragrance while adding colour and warmth to the room.
  • A great gift to give for a birthday, housewarming or whatever the occasion calls for.

products.title: Madhumalti Jewellery Box
products.body_html:
• Named after the madhumalti, a fragrant flowering vine that climbs freely through Indian gardens, this jewellery box carries the same delicate, romantic quality.
  • Its brass frame is topped with a glass lid painted with the vine's blooms, opening to reveal a soft velvet-lined interior for your favourite pieces.
  • Compact enough for a dresser or vanity, it keeps rings, earrings and trinkets safely tucked away while looking beautiful left out on display.
  • A wonderfully personal gift for a wedding, birthday or festive occasion, or a lovely way to organise your own jewellery.

products.title: Bloom Lantern
products.body_html:
• Inspired by the abundant forms of nature found along the banks of the River Krishna, the Bloom Lantern brings the river's magic indoors. Its sculptural silhouette is brought to life in iron and glass, with delicate floral decals in a spirited mix of colours.
  • The matte iron frame lends the piece a softly grounded character, while the glass panels diffuse the warm flicker of candlelight, casting colour and glow around the room.
  • Made for festive evenings, it makes a striking centrepiece on a dining table, console or sideboard, bringing together the beauty of nature and the warmth of light.
  • A great gift to give for a birthday, housewarming or whatever the occasion calls for.

products.title: Leap Photo Frame with Stand
products.body_html:
• The Leap Photo Frame brings a light, sculptural touch to the way you display your favourite memories.
  • Crafted in iron with a matte gold finish, its slim silhouette and sturdy stand make it equally at home on a console, work desk or bedside table.
  • Simple enough to suit any interior, it frames a photograph the way it deserves to be seen.
  • A lovely gift for a wedding, anniversary or housewarming, or a beautiful way to display your own cherished moments.

products.title: Gilded Palm Bookends
products.body_html:
• Inspired by the graceful curve of a palm frond, the Gilded Palm Bookends bring a sculptural, nature-led silhouette to your shelves.
  • Cast in aluminium and finished in a soft matte gold, each bookend has enough heft to hold your favourite reads in place.
  • Equally at home on a bookshelf, console or study table, they turn a functional object into a decorative one.
  • A thoughtful gift for the reader in your life, or a lovely way to style your own shelves this festive season.

products.title: Reesha Toran
products.body_html:
• A traditional welcome for the home, the Reesha Toran is reimagined in warm gold stainless steel for a modern festive entrance.
  • Its delicate, matte-finished form is designed to be hung above a doorway, catching the light as it moves gently in the breeze.
  • Rooted in the age-old custom of adorning the threshold for good fortune, it brings a touch of ritual and celebration to your home all season long.
  • A meaningful gift for a housewarming or festive occasion, or a beautiful way to dress your own front door for Diwali.

products.title: Vatika Cake Knife & Server
products.body_html:
• Designed to accompany the Vatika Cake Stand, this cake knife and server set brings the same quiet elegance to the ritual of cutting a cake.
  • Each piece pairs a matte gold stainless steel blade with a warm wood handle, for a look that's as beautiful as it is functional.
  • Perfectly weighted for slicing and serving cakes, pastries and festive sweets with ease.
  • A thoughtful gift to pair with a cake stand, or a lovely finishing touch to your own dessert table.
    • Dimensions: Server - 25 x 6.5 Cm, Knife - 27 x 2.8 Cm

products.title: Vatika Cake Stand
products.body_html:
• Named for the garden, the Vatika Cake Stand brings a light, glasshouse-like elegance to your dessert table.
  • Its glossy glass dome sits atop a sculpted stand, keeping cakes and pastries fresh while putting them beautifully on display.
  • Perfectly sized for a celebration cake or a tiered arrangement of festive sweets, it turns dessert into the centrepiece of the table.
  • A beautiful gift for a birthday or anniversary, or a lovely addition to your own festive entertaining.
    • Dimensions: Cake Stand - 18 x 18 x 11.8 Cm, Dome - 15.7 x 15.7 x 11.7 Cm

products.title: Crane & tiger bowl S/2 - Red
products.body_html:
• The Crane & Tiger Bowl takes on a fiery new mood in red, its glossy porcelain surface bringing the classic motif of cranes and tigers vividly to life.
  • This set of two nut bowls is compact and beautifully detailed, ideal for serving nuts, dry fruits or festive namkeen.
  • The rich red colourway makes it a natural fit for Diwali and wedding season entertaining.
  • A lovely gift for the host in your life, or a vibrant addition to your own festive serveware.

products.title: Crane & Tiger Bowl Set of 2 - Blue
products.body_html:
• The Crane & Tiger Bowl draws on the timeless imagery of cranes in flight and tigers in motion, rendered here in a rich palette of blue.
  • Crafted in glossy porcelain, each bowl in this set of two carries the intricate motif with striking clarity and colour.
  • Generously sized for a bowl of cereal, curd rice or a comforting soup, they bring a touch of drama to everyday meals.
  • A wonderful gift for someone who loves storytelling tableware, or a statement piece for your own dining table.

products.title: Dhaara Gelato Cup - Set of 4
products.body_html:
• From the Dhaara collection, this set of four gelato cups brings the same gently flowing silhouette to your dessert table.
  • Crafted in brass with a warm matte gold finish, each cup is generously sized to hold a scoop or two of your favourite gelato, kulfi or fruit custard.
  • Their sculptural, rounded form makes them just as lovely for serving nuts or dry fruits at a festive gathering.
  • A thoughtful gift for someone who loves to entertain, or a beautiful addition to your own dessert spread.

products.title: Dhaara Serving Bowl
products.body_html:
• Named for the gentle, unbroken flow of a stream, the Dhaara Serving Bowl carries its name in its silhouette, a softly rounded form finished in warm gold brass.
  • Its matte finish lends the piece an understated elegance, letting the sculptural shape take centre stage on any table.
  • Generously sized, it's equally at home holding a festive biryani, a bowl of fruit or a spread of Diwali sweets.
  • A striking piece to gift for a wedding or housewarming, or a beautiful addition to your own festive serveware.

products.title: Bloom Condiment Jar - Set of 2
products.body_html:
• Part of the Bloom collection, this set of two condiment jars brings the same natural spirit found along the River Krishna to your everyday table.
  • Each jar pairs a glass body with a woven rattan cover and a brass spoon, finished with delicate palm detailing for a look that's as pretty as it is practical.
  • Sized for pickles, chutneys or spices, they keep your favourite condiments close at hand while looking lovely enough to leave out on the table.
  • A sweet little gift for someone who loves to cook, or a charming addition to your own festive spread.

products.title: Bloom Coffee Spoon - Set of 4
products.body_html:
• From the Bloom collection, inspired by the floral abundance found along the River Krishna, this set of four coffee spoons brings a gentle decorative touch to your everyday rituals.
  • Cast in brass with a soft matte gold finish, each spoon carries a delicate floral detail on its handle.
  • Sized just right for stirring an espresso, cappuccino or a small bowl of dessert, they add a festive touch to your morning coffee or after-dinner sweet.
  • A charming gift for the coffee lover in your life, or a lovely detail to add to your own table.

products.title: Bloom Stirrer - Set of 4
products.body_html:
• Part of the Bloom collection, inspired by the abundant floral forms found along the banks of the River Krishna, this set of four stirrers brings a touch of nature to your bar cart.
  • Crafted in brass with a matte gold finish, each stirrer is topped with a delicate floral motif that catches the eye as it rests in a glass.
  • Perfect for stirring a cocktail, mocktail or a simple glass of iced tea, they add a decorative flourish to every pour.
  • A thoughtful little gift on their own, or a lovely add-on to complete a festive bar cart set.

products.title: Reva Sharbat Glass - Set of 4
products.body_html:
• Made for the ritual of sharing a chilled glass of sharbat, the Reva Sharbat Glass is dressed in a lively mix of colours that make even the simplest rose sharbat or nimbu pani feel like an occasion.
  • Each glass in this set of four is crafted in glossy glass, catching the light beautifully whether filled with a rosy sharbat or a festive mocktail.
  • Its compact, gently tapered silhouette sits comfortably in hand, making it as lovely to hold as it is to look at.
  • A charming gift for someone who loves to entertain, or a colourful addition to your own festive bar.

products.title: Vira Cocktail Glass - Set of 4
products.body_html:
• The Vira Cocktail Glass brings a spirited pop of colour to your bar cart, its glossy glass silhouette catching the light with every pour.
  • Each glass in this set of four is finished in a vivid mix of colours, making them as much a design statement as they are a vessel for your favourite cocktail.
  • Generously sized, they're built for everything from a classic mojito to a festive spiced cocktail, and look just as good holding a mocktail at a family gathering.
  • A cheerful set to gift a friend who loves to entertain, or to elevate your own bar cart.

products.title: Buransh Dessert Plate
products.body_html:
• Named after the Nilgiris Buransh, the fiery rhododendron that blooms every spring, this dessert plate carries the flower's bold, cheerful spirit onto your table.
  • Hand-finished in stoneware, each piece is glazed with painterly detailing that celebrates the blossom's warm hues and organic form.
  • Perfectly sized for a slice of cake or a scone, it pairs beautifully with the rest of the Buransh dinnerware for a full festive spread, or stands charmingly on its own.
  • A lovely addition to a housewarming gift or a festive table setting.

products.title: Buransh Espresso Mug - Set of 4
products.body_html:
• Four small mugs for short coffee: two striped in green and white, and two in deep berry with the buransh in bloom.
  • Stoneware, with a handle that gives your finger a little room.
  • The set brings together both Buransh prints: the stripe and the flower.

products.title: Buransh Tea Plate - Set of 4
products.body_html:
• Four tea plates: two in geometric prints, and two in lavender with the buransh bloom at the centre.
  • Stoneware, sized for a biscuit and a cup, a slice of cake, or a small serving of mithai.
  • Two prints in one set, so the four go together without looking too matched.

products.title: Buransh Cookie Tray with Tong
products.body_html:
• A long stoneware tray with a checkerboard base, pink buransh blooms across it, and a tong to go with it.
  • Long and narrow, just right for biscuits, mathri, chocolates or a neat row of canapés.
  • Comes with its own tong, so it is ready to put out as it is.

products.title: Reesha Kulhar - Set of 4
products.body_html:
• The kulhar, the cup chai is drunk from at every station and roadside stall, reimagined here in stoneware.
  • A set of four, with white blossoms across the body for two and a band of green geometic shapes for two.
  • Squat and handle-free in the shape of the original clay cup, so it sits comfortably in the palm.

products.title: Reesha Coasters - Set of 4
products.body_html:
• Four stoneware coasters drawn from the Reesha plates: two in green with white blossoms and two in lavender with the checkerboard.
  • Weighted enough to stay put when a glass is lifted.
  • Two colourways in one set, so a coffee table does not have to match end to end.

products.title: Buransh Straight Mug
products.body_html:
• The buransh in full flower across a deep green base: pink rhododendron, white blossom and grey-green leaves wrapped around a straight-sided mug.
  • Stoneware, with straight walls and a rounded handle, weighted enough to stay put on a desk.
  • The dark base is forgiving of tea stains in a way a white mug rarely is.

products.title: Buransh Conical Mug
products.body_html:
• The buransh bloom sits against a lavender base, wrapped around a mug that tapers towards the bottom.
  • Stoneware, with a handle sized for a whole hand rather than just two fingers.
  • Generously sized, because one fill should be a full cup of coffee, not a polite half.

products.title: Buransh Platter Single
products.body_html:
• Named after the buransh, the rhododendron that blooms across the Nilgiris each spring.
  • A square stoneware platter with rounded corners, painted with the bloom in full: pink flowers, grey-green leaves and grasses across a deep green base.
  • Easy enough to carry in one hand and pass around the room.

products.title: Reesha Pasta Plate
products.body_html:
• A wide rim, a deep well and a green band running around the edge, with a single blossom sprig at the centre.
  • Stoneware, shallow enough to eat from with a fork and deep enough to hold plenty of sauce.
  • The rim brings a little more occasion to the table than the flat plates in the Reesha set.

products.title: Reesha Katori
products.body_html:
• A katori in green and white checks, taking the border pattern from the Reesha plates and giving it a bowl of its own.
  • Stoneware with enough weight to stay put while you serve.
  • Sold as a single katori, so you can build your thali over time.

products.title: Reesha Vegetable Bowl - Set of 2
products.body_html:
• Two serving bowls in the Reesha green: checks in the backgroud, white blossoms across the body, and an ivory interior that lets the food stand out.
  • Stoneware, deep enough for a wet curry and substantial enough to hold warmth on the table.
  • A pair sized for two vegetables, or a vegetable and a dal.

products.title: Reesha Quarter Plate - Green
products.body_html:
• A deep green base scattered with white blossoms, feathered grey leaves, a small kingfisher, flying fish and a checkerboard border running all the way around.
  • Stoneware, finished in a green with plenty of depth.
  • Sold as a single plate, so you can build your set over time or mix it with the lavender version.

products.title: Reesha Quarter Plate - lavender
products.body_html:
• The Reesha print in lavender: white blossoms, feathered grey leaves, a kingfisher mid-flight, flying fish and a checkerboard border.
  • Stoneware with a wash of colour that moves from pale to deep across the face.
  • The second colourway in the Reesha quarter plates, designed to sit alongside the green.

products.title: Toucan Bamboo quarter Plate
products.body_html:
• Toucans, pink blooms and banana leaves come together on a blue base, printed across the full face of the plate.
  • Moulded in bamboo PLA with a matte finish, it has the look of ceramic without much of the weight.
  • Sized between a side plate and a dinner plate, it stacks neatly with the rest of the Toucan bamboo set.

products.title: Reesha Dinner Plate
products.body_html:
• Reesha leaves plenty of room for the food: an ivory face, a single spring of white blossom at the centre, and a fine green chequered border around the rim.
  • Stoneware gives it a reassuring weight, so it stays put when you're cutting into dinner.
  • The quieter piece in the Reesha set, made to sit beneath the patterned quarter plates and katoris.

products.title: Toucan Bamboo Tumbler
products.body_html:
• The Toucan print wraps around a lightweight straight-sided tumbler in dusty blue.
  • Made from bamboo PLA with a matte finish, it is slim enough to hold in one hand and narrow enough for a fridge shelf.
  • Part of a three-piece Toucan set, alongside the plate and cereal bowl.

products.title: Toucan Bamboo Cereal Bowl
products.body_html:
• A cereal bowl in a pink base, a toucan and blooms around the outside, and a deep well inside.
  • Made from bamboo PLA with a matte finish, it is light in the hand and steady on the table.
  • One of three pieces in the Toucan bamboo set, alongside the plate and tumbler.

products.title: Cirrus Shirt - Electric Blue
products.body_html:
• The Cirrus Shirt is a beautiful piece with delicate embroidery. It is an ideal choice for casual events and parties.
  • Find beautiful flower motif embroidery on the shirt.
  • Details of check fabric as trims.
  • Pairs perfectly with White Yoka Pants.

products.title: Happy Heart Dress - Navy & Ochre
products.body_html:
• This navy dress with ochre heart print has spiritual and cultural significance, it denotes the healing practices in the region and has the perfect combination of whimsical and modern
  • Crafted in 100% organic cotton voile

products.title: Bug Brooch - Gold
products.body_html:
• Our newest season of Aparna Chandra for Nicobar; an indulgent handcrafted jewellery line that's all twinkle and celebration
  • Crafted in antique brass, our bug brooch is embedded with a green zircon stone and red enamel
  • Perfect for gifting or to keep

products.title: Bee Brooch - Gold
products.body_html:
• Our newest season of Aparna Chandra for Nicobar; an indulgent handcrafted jewellery line that's all twinkle and celebration
  • Crafted in brass with a gold finish, this brooch will dress up your shirts and kurtas
  • Perfect for gifting or to keep

products.title: Kovvur Kurta Set
products.body_html:
• Effortless and timeless, the Kovvur Kurta Set is designed for days that move seamlessly from everyday moments to festive gatherings.
  • The Kovvur Kurta is crafted from lightweight cotton silk, with soft abstract prints, delicate hand-smocked pleats beneath the yoke and shell buttons that lend the classic A-line silhouette a fresh, contemporary spirit.
  • The matching trousers are cut from breathable Bemberg, a soft regenerated cellulose fibre with a clean, narrow silhouette that lets the fabric's natural drape and lustre shine through.
  • Wear them together for easy, elevated dressing, or style each piece with the separates you already own.

products.title: Midnight Vase Set
products.body_html:
• Decorate your space with seasonal blossoms with the Midnight Vase Set. The set includes the Dhaara Vase and the Nadi Vase.
  • Made from iron, the stark design and bold look of the Dhaara Vase always stand out.

  • Crafted in Bemberg, the fabric is smooth, breathable and fluid, with a soft drape that skims the body without feeling restrictive. Crafted from cotton linter, a natural byproduct of cottonseed oil production, Bemberg is a regenerated cellulose fibre that drapes like silk, is soft, breathable, and gentle on the skin. It’s biodegradable, compostable, and made using a closed-loop process that minimises waste, making it a thoughtful choice for you and the planet.
  • A softly gathered cowl neckline falls into slim straps, with strap closures at the back for an adjustable fit, finished with a baby hem.
  • A tiny fuchsia heart embroidered below the back strap adds an unexpected flash of colour to the monochrome print.
  • A romantic silhouette made for dinners, cocktails and evenings out, with just enough polish to carry you from one to the next.

products.title: Revel Top - Bemberg Regular Fit
products.body_html:
• NicoSera takes its name from the Italian word for evening, that golden hour when the day loosens its collar and the night begins. Made for late dinners, glowing rooms and the pleasure of getting dressed for what comes next. The Revel Top brings a quiet polish to everyday dressing, cut in black with a softly fluid silhouette and a little drama at the cuff.
  • Crafted in Bemberg, the fabric is smooth, breathable and fluid, with a subtle sheen and an easy drape that moves beautifully with the body. Crafted from cotton linter, a natural byproduct of cottonseed oil production, Bemberg is a regenerated cellulose fibre that drapes like silk, is soft, breathable, and gentle on the skin. It’s biodegradable, compostable, and made using a closed-loop process that minimises waste, making it a thoughtful choice for you and the planet.
  • The split neckline flows into a gathered tie-up detail, while raglan sleeves keep the shape relaxed and comfortable.
  • Look closer at the details: the tie ends are finished with metal ends, a small red heart is embroidered at one end, and a black-and-white checked button closes each cuff.
  • Made for workdays that turn into dinners, it slips easily between tailored trousers and more relaxed bottoms.

products.title: Whirl Tie Up Top - Cotton Silk Regular Fit
products.body_html:
• NicoSera takes its name from the Italian word for evening, that golden hour when the day loosens its collar and the night begins. Made for late dinners, glowing rooms and the pleasure of getting dressed for what comes next. The Whirl Tie Up Top brings a little graphic play to an otherwise considered silhouette, pairing an ivory base with oversized black polka dots.
  • Crafted in cotton silk, the fabric is lightweight and softly crisp, with a delicate handfeel that gives the relaxed shape an easy fluidity.
  • A doubled neck scarf creates the defining detail, cut in the same printed fabric and finished with a neat baby hem along its edge.
  • Raglan sleeves keep the fit easy, while a tiny fuchsia heart embroidered at the cuff adds an unexpected flash of colour.
  • Black-and-ivory gingham peeks from inside the cuffs, a small contrast detail that only reveals itself in motion.
  • Designed for evenings away and special occasions, wear it tied at the neck or let the scarf fall loose with relaxed trousers or a flowing skirt.

products.title: Madagascar Dinner Set (Set of 2)
products.body_html:
• A set of 2 dinner plates, 2 quarter plates and 2 katoris — a two-cover setting with motifs inspired by the indigenous flora and fauna of Madagascar.
  • The dinner and quarter plates carry the tropical setting across the table, while the two katoris bring a small surprise to each cover with a lemur on one and a toucan on the other.
  • Built for intimate dinners for two and weekend lunches with character. Pair with linen napkins and a glass carafe for water, and let the prints do the rest.

products.title: The Basic Long Length Kurta Set - Green
products.body_html:
• A set of two of our signature styles, the Basic Long Length Kurta and Basic Pyjamas in green.
  • This easy-wearing kurta falls below the knee, and with its body-skimming fit, it pairs perfectly with pyjamas or a pair of jeans. The green hue and relaxed cut makes it easy to pair with any outfit, adding a touch of effortless style to your look.
  • Elevate your style effortlessly with the most versatile addition to your wardrobe - a pair of pants that seamlessly complement any look, whether dressed up or dressed down.

products.title: Hera Halter Kurta Set
products.body_html:
• The Hera Halter Kurta Set pairs romantic florals with clean, contemporary tailoring, a co-ord that feels graceful and easy in equal measure.
  • Cut from lightweight cotton kora, the halter kurta stays breathable while layers of rose embroidery, scalloped lace and subtle sequin detailing give the design real depth.
  • The straight-leg Nadi pants add a fresh, colour-blocked character in breathable cotton, finished with subtle embroidery that rewards a closer look.
  • Wear the set together for occasions that call for quiet elegance, or split the pieces across your wardrobe with separates of your own.

products.title: Happy Heart Dress - Ink Blue & Red Embroidered
products.body_html:
• The Happy Heart Dress arrives scattered with flowers, embroidered across an ink-blue base that feels summer-ready.
  • Crafted in 100% cotton poplin, the fabric is crisp yet light, holding the shape of the dress while staying comfortable through warmer days.
  • Cross-stitch floral embroidery brings texture and depth to the rich blue base.
  • A shirt collar and half sleeves add structure, balancing the softness of the embroidery with clean, everyday lines.
  • Cut in an easy A-line silhouette with discreet side pockets, the Happy Heart Dress is made to be worn and loved.

products.title: Kuro Dress - Charcoal & White Printed
products.body_html:
• The Kuro Dress does not follow a straight line.
  • Charcoal stripes move across the surface in an irregular rhythm, bringing a sense of movement from the first glance.
  • Crafted in 100% organic cotton voile, the fabric is light and airy, allowing the A-line silhouette to fall with ease.
  • The bodice is cut on the straight grain while the skirt shifts off-grain, changing the way the stripes sit and flow.
  • A fuchsia heart button at the collar and a patchwork heart at the back add unexpected touches.
  • Finished with a shirt collar, half sleeves, and a baby-hem edge, it's made for city afternoons and slow mornings away.

products.title: Ezra Dress - Grey & White Checks
products.body_html:
• The Ezra Dress plays with direction.
  • Charcoal and white checks run through the body, while a bias-cut hem panel shifts the pattern and changes the way it moves.
  • Crafted in a linen-cotton blend, the fabric combines the crispness of linen with the softness of cotton, creating a silhouette that holds its shape with ease.
  • The checks feel graphic and grounded, interrupted at the hem by the change in direction.
  • A red star embroidery below the neckline adds a quiet detail, while the sleeveless cut, V-neckline, and A-line shape make it an easy companion from AM to PM.

products.title: The Monkey Rakhi Set
products.body_html:

  • It includes our Monkey Rakhi and Monkey Keychain, both crafted in brass, with the rakhi finished in 18 carat pure gold plating.

• The Vintage Car Rakhi Set brings together two keepsakes that celebrate shared journeys, old memories and the adventures still to come.
  • It includes our Vintage Car Rakhi and Motor Cycle Rakhi, both crafted in brass and finished with 18 carat pure gold plating.
