  • It includes our Dil Rakhi and matching Dil Charmlet, both crafted in brass and finished with 18 carat pure gold plating.
  • The rakhi is tied with a traditional mauli thread, while the Dil Charmlet is designed to be worn on your Nicobar Charm Bracelet long after the celebrations are over.
  • Beautifully presented in a ready-to-ship giftable envelope with a card inside to hold your thoughts even closer.
  • Thoughtful together, timeless forever, it's a gift made to be cherished long after the day is over.

products.title: Ceylon Comfort Set
products.body_html:
• The Ceylon Comfort Set brings you warmth in mugs and bowls, perfect to curl up and get cosy with. The set comes with the Ceylon Trail Shallow Bowl - Set of 2, the Ceylon Lush Straight Mug and the Ceylon Trail Straight Mug.
  • A must- have for hearty one-pot meals the Ceylon Shallow Bowls are perfect for serving decadent dishes.
  • The Ceylon Trail Straight Mug is inspired by our travels to Sri Lanka—perfect for holding and savouring your favourite brews.
  • The Ceylon Lush Straight Mug is inspired by our travels to Sri Lanka—perfect for holding and savouring your favourite brews.

products.title: Botanical Dinner set (Set of 2)
products.body_html:
• A set of 2 dinner plates, 2 quarter plates, 2 katoris, 1 large serving bowl, and 1 small serving bowl — a full hosting kit for two in glossy porcelain, with little printed motifs picked from nature scattered across each piece.
  • The porcelain holds its glaze and shine through repeat use, and the prints sit clean against any neutral table. Mix and match with contrasting tableware from past collections to switch up the setting, or let the Botanical pieces hold the table on their own.
  • Made for weekend lunches, festive evenings with the family, and any occasion where serving generously is part of the welcome. Style with linen runners, a few low candles, and a centrepiece of fresh greens.

products.title: Summer Fun Kurta Set
products.body_html:
• Light-hearted and easy, the Summer Fun Kurta Set captures the joy of warm-weather dressing.
  • The sleeveless Summer Fun kurta is cut from breathable cotton, with thoughtful embroidery, colourful stitching and shell buttons bringing playful character to a clean silhouette.
  • The Avent pants ground it in garment-dyed linen, naturally breathable with a softer texture that develops over time.
  • Wear the set together for holidays and weekend lunches, or mix each piece with your summer separates.

products.title: Amrai Kurta Set
products.body_html:
• The Amrai Kurta Set brings intricate embroidery to an easy cotton co-ord you'll reach for year after year.
  • The Amrai kurta is cut from breathable cotton, with beautiful cross-stitch detailing, flared sleeves, delicate lace finishes and a thoughtfully designed slip.
  • The Raahi pants echo the handcrafted feel with floral embroidery on breathable cotton, a relaxed silhouette and an easy elasticated waist.
  • Wear the set together to let the craftsmanship take centre stage, or pair each piece with simple separates of your own.

products.title: Konark Kurta Set
products.body_html:
• Classic stripes take on a softer, more elegant expression in the Konark Kurta Set, a refined co-ord with handcrafted detail throughout.
  • The Konark kurta is cut from cotton silk with a delicate sheen, shaped with structured pleats and finished with embroidered floral details on a clean A-line silhouette.
  • The Kintara pants bring intricate embroidery to breathable cotton in a narrow silhouette, keeping the craftsmanship front and centre.
  • Style the set together with gold jewellery for festive lunches and celebrations, or wear each piece on its own for elegant everyday dressing.

products.title: Mati Shirt Set
products.body_html:
• The Mati Shirt Set brings together two garment-dyed linen pieces into a timeless co-ord built to improve with every wear.
  • The Mati shirt is crafted from soft 100% linen with a rich, lived-in depth of colour, finished with shell buttons and a subtle metal heart beneath the back yoke.
  • The Avent pants match it in garment-dyed linen, with an extended waistband and refined construction that stay polished without ever feeling restrictive.
  • Wear the linen set together for a considered head-to-toe look, or mix each piece with denim and cotton separates through the seasons.

products.title: Kolva Kurta Set
products.body_html:
• The Kolva Kurta Set takes an everyday cotton co-ord and lifts it with unexpected touches of colour.
  • The Kolva kurta is cut from breathable 100% cotton, with silver zari topstitching and rainbow sequin embroidery bringing small moments of celebration to a clean silhouette.
  • Narrow cotton pants keep the look streamlined and comfortable, lifted by delicate embroidered detailing and an easy elasticated waist.
  • Wear the set together for workdays, festive lunches or relaxed evenings, or style each piece into your everyday separates.

products.title: Talsari Shirt Set
products.body_html:
• The Talsari Shirt Set pairs two relaxed, embroidered pieces into a co-ord that feels soft, easy and quietly striking.
  • The Talsari shirt is cut from breathable cotton in a loose, kaftan-inspired shape, with delicate rose embroidery, an asymmetrical hem and monochrome shell buttons.
  • The Raahi pants follow with a relaxed silhouette and uneven hem in breathable cotton, finished with intricate floral embroidery and an easy elasticated waist.
  • Wear the set together for an easy, considered look, or pair each piece with denim and separates of your own.

products.title: Daman Top Set
products.body_html:
• The Daman Top Set brings together a playful polka print and clean tailoring for a co-ord that feels light and quietly feminine.
  • The Daman top is cut from lightweight fabric with an easy silhouette, finished with embroidered motifs, scalloped lace and adjustable straps for the perfect fit.
  • Narrow cotton pants ground the look in clean, versatile charcoal, with a subtle embroidered heart tucked in as a Nicobar signature.
  • Wear the two together for warm afternoons into evenings out, or style each piece on its own.

products.title: Basic Long Length Kurta Set
products.body_html:
• The Basic Long Length Kurta Set proves that simplicity can be the most sophisticated choice, clean lines with detail kept close.
  • The long-length kurta is cut from a soft silk blend with gentle structure, its embroidery hidden within the placket and along the back to reward a closer look.
  • Narrow cotton pants in charcoal keep the line clean and streamlined, with a subtle embroidered heart adding a quiet Nicobar signature.
  • Wear the set together for a polished head-to-toe look, or style each piece back into your everyday separates.

products.title: Narsa Kurta Set
products.body_html:
• Delicate florals meet clean colour in the Narsa Kurta Set, an easy pairing made for everyday elegance.
  • The Narsa kurta is cut from breathable cotton, with a flattering V-neckline, gently flared sleeves and intricate embroidery that takes centre stage.
  • Narrow cotton poplin pants ground it with crisp structure and bold colour, a refreshing change from everyday neutrals.
  • Wear the set together for an easy, elegant look, or let each piece find its own place in your wardrobe.

products.title: Tuni Kurta Set
products.body_html:
• Fresh and playful, the Tuni Kurta Set brings personality to everyday dressing through easy shapes and handcrafted detail.
  • The Tuni kurta is cut from soft, breathable cotton, with a panelled wrap neckline, crochet lace and contrast fagotting for a thoughtful handcrafted finish.
  • The Bora pants answer it with a relaxed balloon silhouette in breathable cotton, contrast stitching and a vibrant print that keeps things lively.
  • Wear the two together for an easy day-to-evening look, or pull each into the rest of your wardrobe on its own.

products.title: The Lehar Top Set - Grey & White
products.body_html:

  • Together, the set blends graphic checks, handwork, and thoughtful accents.

products.title: Classic Bi-Fold Wallet - Denim Blue

products.title: Tahr Bandhgala - Beige

Monogrammed buttons bearing the Rajesh Pratap Singh logo, and the collaboration mnemonic logo embroidered at the front side panel. Detail that earns its place.
  • Slim fit. Part of the RPS x Nicobar SS26 collection . Named for the Nilgiri Tahr, a creature that moves through difficult terrain with complete unhurried certainty.

products.title: Neelakurinji Printed Lumbar Cushion
products.body_html:
• The Neelakurinji is a lumbar that rewards close looking. A composed floral arrangement on indigo denim, finished in gold and silver embroidery.
  • Indigo denim lumbar. Block printed with a floral arrangement that reads as placed rather than repeating. The denim gives it real weight and body. It holds its shape.
  • Propped on a reading chair where its proportions match the armrest. Along a window seat where a row of them makes a full backrest. On a bed as the one small finishing detail.
  • Part of the RPS x Nicobar collection. Named for the Neelakurinji. A flower that blooms once in twelve years. This one stays.
  • Style it with: The Mistflower Crewel Cushion. Same indigo denim, same metallic palette, different format.

products.title: Mistflower Crewel Cushion
products.body_html:
• Block printed first, then embroidered. The Mistflower layers two techniques on indigo denim because one was not enough to say what it needed to.
  • Indigo denim. Gold highlights on the central chamunti flower, silver on the smaller blooms on either side. Two metals, two scales of flower, one considered composition. It reads across a room.
  • The anchor cushion on a low sofa or diwan. A bedroom where the bed is dressed simply and the accents carry the room. A centrepiece where everything else defers to it.
  • Part of the RPS x Nicobar collection. Named for the Mistflower. Chamunti flowers at rest, expressed in indigo and careful craft.
  • Style it with: The Javandi Crewel Cushion for an indigo pairing with different textures. Or the Chandramallika runner for a full-room conversation in the same motif.

products.title: Javandi Crewel Cushion
products.body_html:
• No print underneath, no pattern to follow. The Javandi builds its entire surface from thread on indigo denim. Crewel embroidery, start to finish.
  • Indigo denim base. The denim gives the embroidery a ground with real weight. Crewel uses wool thread on a woven base, building dimension stitch by stitch. Chrysanthemum forms shaped entirely through craft.
  • A wooden daybed where it holds its own against hard surfaces. A dark sofa where the indigo blends and the threadwork stands forward. A study where textiles lean towards the handmade.
  • Part of the RPS x Nicobar collection. Named for the Javandi. A flower known through touch as much as sight.
  • Style it with: The Mistflower Crewel Cushion. Both sit on indigo denim, both use embroidery, but the technique and the metallic accents make them distinct.

products.title: Guldaudi Printed Lumbar Cushion
products.body_html:

  • Cotton satin lumbar. Block printed with chrysanthemum blooms, finished with hand embroidery in gold and silver on the first and third flowers. Adorned, plain, adorned.
  • Evening entertaining when metallic catches the room. A daybed that needs one finished piece among linens. A standalone accent on a bench or window seat.
  • Part of the RPS x Nicobar collection. Named for the Guldaudi, the chrysanthemum of festive garlands and traditional ceremony.
  • Style it with: The Sevanthi Printed Cushion. Same block print language, different shape, different embroidery placement.

products.title: Sevanthi Printed Cushion
products.body_html:
• The Sevanthi is block print and embroidery on the same surface, but the embroidery knows when to stop. One flower gets the gold and silver. The rest stay flat.
  • Cotton satin. Block printed with a chrysanthemum repeat, then finished by hand. Gold and silver embroidery on the middle flower only. One accent, placed with intention.
  • A sofa alongside solid-toned cushions. A reading nook where one printed piece sets the mood. A festival arrangement that feels considered rather than overdone.
  • Part of the RPS x Nicobar collection. Named for the Sevanthi, the hill-grown chrysanthemum that shows up in garlands, on thresholds, in the everyday.
  • Style it with: The Guldaudi Printed Lumbar for a print-meets-print pairing held together through shared craft.

products.title: Shola Variegated Cushion
products.body_html:
• The Shola takes the same pintuck technique as the Champaca and breaks the rhythm. Tucks that graduate, spacing that shifts, light that lands unevenly.
  • Cotton satin. The variegated pintucks give it a different visual weight than the Champaca. More shadow, more depth. No print, no embroidery. Entirely constructed. The reference is the Nilgiri shola forest: layered, dappled, never uniform.
  • A living room where the furniture is simple and the textiles do the talking. A daybed where you want texture without pattern. A cushion arrangement where it anchors the group.
  • Part of the RPS x Nicobar collection. Named for the shola forests of the Nilgiris. Dense, still, full of movement if you look long enough.
  • Style it with: The Nilgiri Champaca Pintuck Cushion. Same fabric, same technique, different rhythm.

products.title: Nilgiri Champaca Pintuck Cushion
products.body_html:
• The Nilgiri Champaca is a cushion with nothing on its surface but construction. No print, no embroidery. Just pintucks catching light.
  • Cotton satin. The fabric has a natural sheen that the pintucks interrupt and redirect. Vertical pintucks run the full face. The signature detail of the Rajesh Pratap Singh studio: precise where everything else is fluid.
  • A linen sofa where it catches afternoon light. A reading corner against darker upholstery. A made bed where it holds its own among prints.
  • Part of the RPS x Nicobar collection. Named for the Nilgiri champaca blossom. White, unfussy, known for what it carries rather than how it looks.
  • Style it with: The Shola Variegated Cushion for two textures in conversation. Or let it sit alone. It does not need company.

  • Cut in yarn-dyed cotton, the stripes run fine and even. A shirt with the crispness of pressed cotton and the ease of something broken in.
  • The boxy fit gives it room to move, sitting easily over trousers or shorts without looking overdone.
  • Built for brunches and long lunches. Pair with linen trousers and sandals for summer Sundays, or with denim and sneakers for something more relaxed.
  • A unisex style designed to be worn by everyone, this piece belongs in every wardrobe.

products.title: Classic Shirt - Brown Embroidered
products.body_html:
• This unisex style is made for men and women, designed to be shared and styled your way.
  • A solid shirt with a quirk tucked inside it. The Classic Shirt in brown carries a cross-stitched pixelated heart as its signature, done in computer embroidery that holds sharpness across the details.
  • Made in a linen-cotton blend with the warmth and drape of a well-chosen solid.
  • The fit is classic, easy across the shoulders and easy through the body.
  • The embroidery sits as a small counterpoint to the solid ground. Enough to catch the eye, not enough to shout.
  • Works for elevated everyday wear. Layer over a white tee for weekends, tuck into linen trousers for evening dinners, or wear on its own with the sleeves rolled for that in-between zone between office and off-duty.
  • A unisex style designed to be worn by everyone, this piece belongs in every wardrobe.

products.title: Rewa Shirt - Navy
products.body_html:
• A workshirt that wears its heart at the back. The Rewa shirt keeps things sharp at the front, with a pixelated heart embroidered in red thread at the centre back yoke as the small, personal turn.
  • Cut from a linen-cotton blend in solid navy, with a selvedge detail at the back that signals the honesty of the weave.
  • The fit runs slim and the silhouette stays clean, built to tuck in and hold its line through a long desk day.
  • Pair with tailored trousers for workwear days, or with the Pravah Trousers and leather loafers for meetings that matter. Untuck it over denim when the working day is done.

products.title: Zahra Blouse - Red & White Stripes
products.body_html:
• A blouse that balances nostalgia with a crisp, modern ease. The Zahra blouse draws you in with its red and white stripes, playful yet composed, like a memory of summer carried into the present.
  • Cut from a cotton viscose mushru blend, it holds a soft sheen against the skin while staying breathable through long hours. The fabric moves lightly, giving structure without stiffness.
  • At the neckline, delicate dori ties finish with tassel details, small accents that add movement and a quiet sense of craft. They frame the blouse gently, letting you adjust the look from relaxed to refined.
  • The fit is tailored and close to the body, designed to sit neatly without feeling restrictive.
  • Pair it with high-waisted trousers for a clean, everyday statement, or style it with fluid skirts when you want something softer. It transitions effortlessly, meant for days that don’t stay in one place for long.

products.title: Nimar Long Shirt - Red & Navy Striped
products.body_html:
• The Nimar Long Shirt in red and navy striped is a bold yet easy piece, defined by its elongated silhouette and rhythmic stripe pattern.
  • Cut from 100% cotton voile, the fabric is lightweight and breathable, with rotary screen-printed red and navy stripes that bring energy and movement to the design.
  • The stripes create a striking visual balance, making the shirt stand out while remaining effortlessly wearable.
  • Pocket bags and facing are crafted in shell fabric, ensuring a clean, cohesive finish throughout.
  • A twill tape loop at the sleeve hemline adds a subtle functional detail, reinforcing the garment’s thoughtful construction.
  • At the back, a pixel heart embroidery in red and blue sits just above the yoke seam, introducing a small, playful signature element.
  • Designed for versatile styling, the Nimar Long Shirt can be worn on its own or layered, offering multiple ways to style a statement everyday piece.

products.title: Noor Sari - Navy & Red
products.body_html:
• A sari that feels both rooted and quietly expressive. The Noor sari comes alive in a deep navy, framed with a striking red border that brings just the right note of contrast.
  • Woven in 100% cotton yarn-dyed fabric, it carries a sense of everyday ease with a finish that stays crisp through long wear. The texture feels breathable and dependable, made for movement and time.
  • The pallu is finished cleanly along the inside edge, allowing the details to stand out with intention. At both ends, delicate crochet tassels add a soft, handcrafted touch that moves with you.
  • Small cross-stitch hearts in red and white sit thoughtfully at both ends of the pallu, placed just off the selvedge and above the hem. Subtle yet personal, they bring a hint of playfulness to a classic drape.
  • Style it with a fitted blouse for a sharp, traditional look, or keep it relaxed with softer silhouettes. It’s a piece that moves easily between everyday wear and moments that call for something a little more considered.
  • Dimensions: Length: 5.5 Mtrs | Width: 46” (1.17 Mtrs)

products.title: Sondar Sari - Blue & White Printed
products.body_html:
• A sari that feels light as air and quietly vibrant. The Sondar sari is set against a deep blue base, scattered with white bougainvillea prints that evoke a sense of easy, sunlit days.
  • Crafted in 100% cotton kota, it carries a natural lightness and airy texture that drapes effortlessly. The fabric’s subtle transparency adds depth while staying comfortable and breathable.
  • The simplicity of the finish allows the print to take centre stage, keeping the look clean and unfussy. Every detail feels considered without overwhelming the ease of the piece.
  • Fluid in its fall and gentle in its presence, the silhouette moves with you, making it ideal for long, unhurried days.
  • Style it with a minimal blouse to let the print stand out, or layer with soft contrasts for a more expressive look. It’s a sari that brings together lightness, colour, and everyday wearability with quiet charm.
  • Dimensions: Length: 5.5 Mtrs | Width: 46” (1.17 Mtrs)

products.title: Noor Sari - Blue & Chartreuse
products.body_html:
• A sari that brings the lightness of summer alive. The Noor sari unfolds in a rich blue, lifted by a chartreuse border that adds a fresh, unexpected edge.
  • Crafted in 100% cotton yarn-dyed fabric, it feels light, breathable, and easy to wear through the day. The weave holds its structure while remaining soft against the skin.
  • The pallu and inside edges are clean finished, keeping the overall look sharp and considered. Tassel details at both ends of the pallu introduce a gentle movement, adding to its handcrafted appeal.
  • Delicate floral embroidery sits at both ends of the pallu, placed thoughtfully just off the selvedge and above the hem. Roses and parijaat-inspired blooms come alive in soft pink, muted blue, and white threads, with a small blue dot detail that ties it all together. The motif feels subtle, almost like a quiet signature.
  • Pair it with a tonal blouse for a refined look, or contrast it with softer hues to bring out the embroidery. It’s a sari that carries ease and detail in equal measure, suited for days that flow from one moment to the next.
  • Dimensions: Length: 5.5 Mtrs | Width: 46” (1.17 Mtrs)

products.title: Inara Dupatta - Ice Blue & Red Printed
products.body_html:
• A dupatta that feels light, fluid, and quietly expressive. The Inara dupatta is set on an ice blue base, brought to life with red bougainvillea prints that add a gentle yet striking contrast.
  • Crafted from cotton linter, a natural byproduct of cottonseed oil production, Bemberg is a regenerated cellulose fibre that’s soft, breathable, and gentle on the skin. It’s biodegradable, compostable, and made using a closed-loop process that minimises waste, making it a thoughtful choice for you and the planet.
  • The print flows across the surface with a natural rhythm, creating a balance between colour and calm. It lends just enough detail without overwhelming the look.
  • Lightweight and versatile, it layers seamlessly over both structured and relaxed silhouettes, adding a touch of freshness to any outfit.
  • Style it with coordinated tones for a cohesive look, or let it stand out against deeper hues. It’s a piece that brings ease, colour, and movement together in a way that feels both everyday and considered.

products.title: Samya Dupatta - Ivory & Red Printed
products.body_html:
• A dupatta that feels soft, luminous, and quietly elegant. The Samya dupatta rests on an ivory base, brought alive with red bougainvillea that add a gentle burst of colour.
  • Crafted in soft chanderi, it carries a light, airy texture with a subtle sheen that catches the light as you move. The fabric feels delicate yet holds its presence with ease.
  • The print spreads with a natural rhythm across the surface, creating a balance between softness and vibrancy. It keeps the look refined while still feeling expressive.
  • Easy to drape and effortless to style, it layers beautifully over both everyday and occasion wear, adding a touch of brightness without overpowering.
  • Pair it with tonal ensembles for a cohesive feel, or contrast it with deeper hues to let the bougainvillea stand out. It’s a piece that brings lightness and colour together in a way that feels timeless and versatile.

products.title: Ambrai Jacket - Blue Stripes
products.body_html:
• A jacket that brings a sense of play to a clean, everyday staple. The Ambrai jacket is rendered in bright blue and Carolina blue stripes, creating a tonal rhythm that feels both fresh and easy.
  • Crafted in 100% cotton yarn-dyed stripes, it offers a breathable structure with a crisp hand feel. The fabric holds its shape while remaining comfortable through the day.
  • Piping at the pocket openings adds a subtle finish, sharpening the edges without drawing too much attention. It’s a detail that keeps the piece feeling considered and complete.
  • Scattered across the jacket, cross-stitch embroideries introduce moments of charm. A small heart appears on the front lapel, an owl rests at the back panel next to the cactus, a butterfly flutters onto the upper back, and a chillie sits at the pocket edge. Each motif feels like a quiet, personal mark.
  • The silhouette stays easy and versatile, designed to layer without effort. It works across seasons and settings, adapting to how you wear it.
  • Style it over dresses for a soft contrast, or pair it with structured separates for a more defined look. It’s a piece that blends craft, colour, and everyday functionality with ease.

variants.title: Bright Blue & Carolina Blue / Free Size

products.title: Yoka Trousers - Blue & White Checks
products.body_html:
• The Yoka Trousers in blue are a relaxed essential, defined by their easy silhouette and classic checked pattern.
  • Cut from 100% yarn-dyed cotton, the fabric offers a soft, breathable feel, with blue monotone checks that bring a quiet, timeless character.
  • The pattern adds gentle structure without overpowering, making the trousers versatile for everyday wear.
  • A small heart embroidery at the outer corner of the pocket introduces a subtle, playful detail that adds personality to the piece.
  • Designed in a relaxed fit, the Yoka Trousers prioritise comfort and ease, making them ideal for all-day wear while maintaining a clean, composed look. Easy to pair with basics or something more special.

products.title: Reyat Skirt- Blue & White Stripes
products.body_html:
• The Reyat Skirt in blue striped is a playful yet composed piece, defined by its crisp stripe pattern and thoughtful accents. The striped pattern brings a sense of movement, balancing structure with an easy, relaxed drape.
  • Cut from 100% cotton voile, the fabric is light and breathable, with navy stripes screen-printed on a fresh white base for a clean, summery feel.
  • Pocket bags are crafted in shell fabric, while hanger loops add everyday practicality without disrupting the design.
  • Pintuck detailing along the waistband introduces subtle texture, complemented by elastic smocking at the sides that adds both comfort and a pop of contrast.
  • A baby overlock finishes the hemline, giving the skirt a delicate yet distinctive edge.
  • At the front, a braided anchor thread tassel detail with a small beaded flower adds a handcrafted, signature touch that elevates the overall look.

products.title: Salem Pants - Blue Stripes
products.body_html:
• The Salem Pants in blue are a refined everyday essential, defined by their clean striped pattern and subtle detailing. The barrel silhouette makes a statement with ease.
  • Cut from 100% cotton yarn-dyed stripes, the fabric offers a soft yet structured feel, with blue monotone stripes that create a calm, cohesive look.
  • The pattern keeps things understated, allowing the texture and precision of the stripes to bring quiet character to the piece.
  • Pocket bags are crafted in shell fabric, maintaining a seamless finish, while hanger loops add ease to everyday care.
  • Just below, a small red heart embroidery sits thoughtfully placed near the pocket, adding a subtle signature touch to the garment.
  • Designed for versatile styling, the Salem Pants transition effortlessly across settings, offering a balanced mix of simplicity and detail.

products.title: Kasra Pants - Red & Navy Stripes
products.body_html:
• The Kasra Pants in red are a bold, easygoing staple, defined by their striking striped pattern and relaxed appeal. Rendered in alternating red and navy rotary screen-printed stripes, the design brings rhythm and retro energy to the silhouette.
  • Cut from 100% cotton voile, the fabric is lightweight and breathable, offering a soft, airy feel that moves effortlessly through the day.
  • Pocket bags are crafted in shell fabric, keeping the finish clean and cohesive while maintaining everyday functionality.
  • At the waistband, denim hanger loops and a drawstring with red kantha twill tape introduce a subtle contrast detail, adding depth to the overall look.
  • Designed in a narrow fit, the Kasra Pants balance comfort and structure, making them an easy choice for both relaxed and styled-up everyday wear.

products.title: Serene Pants - Ivory & Red Embroidered
products.body_html:
• The Serene Pants in ivory are a soft, elevated essential, defined by their light, calming tone and easy elegance.
  • Cut from 100% cotton kora, the fabric feels breathable and natural, offering a gentle structure while remaining comfortable through the day.
  • Set against a solid ivory base, all-over cross stitch embroidery adds quiet texture and depth, bringing a handcrafted character to the piece.
  • Thoughtful details include hanger loops in shell fabric, designed for ease of care while keeping the finish refined and cohesive.
  • The embroidery does the storytelling here, subtle yet intricate, lending the pants a timeless charm that works across occasions.
  • Designed for versatile styling, the Serene Pants pair effortlessly with both relaxed and more structured tops, making them a dependable choice for everyday wear with a touch of artisanal detail.

products.title: Azara Pants - Blue
products.body_html:
• The Azara Pants are a clean navy foundation, a single, strong colour shaped for everyday tailoring.
  • Cut from 100% cotton poplin with a paper finish in solid navy, the fabric has a crisp, structured handfeel that holds its line through the day.
  • A grounded navy that quietly partners with almost anything in the wardrobe.
  • Pocket bags are cut in the shell fabric and a black jaggered-stripe twill tape is set inside the waistband, hidden details that reward a closer look.
  • A Nicobar label tassel sits at the inside side seam at the waistband, finished with red edge embroidery and a small metal red heart coin, a signature moment inside the garment.
  • A narrow fit, designed to pair for office and everyday with both the Niva Shirt in white and the Zaya Top in navy-and-white stripes, one pair of pants, many possible looks.

products.title: Bina Dress - Multicolour Stripes
products.body_html:
• The Bina Dress is a quiet celebration of the stripe, grey, ivory, and green running vertically to lengthen a fit-and-flare silhouette.
  • Crafted in linen-cotton, the fabric has a cool, textured handfeel of linen softened by cotton's ease.
  • Side pockets are cut in the shell fabric so the stripes continue uninterrupted, and the straps are finished with a broad black-and-white striped cotton twill tape, a subtle contrast that echoes the rhythm of the main cloth.
  • A fit-and-flare silhouette shaped for movement, cut to skim the body and open into ease at the hem.
  • Easy for holiday and everyday wear, worn alone through warm days or layered over a simple tee.

products.title: Savni Dress - Red
products.body_html:
• The Savni Dress is a single, confident red, a slip-easy A-line cut to move with the body and catch the light.
  • Crafted in Bemberg in solid red, the fabric has a soft, fluid hand that drapes beautifully and carries a gentle sheen against the skin.
  • A solid colour does the speaking, letting the silhouette and the fabric's weight hold the room on their own.
  • A small sequin heart sits hidden next to the inside side seam, placed by sample, a quiet, personal motif that only the wearer knows.
  • An A-line cut for evening wear and holiday, worn with bare sandals or layered under a light jacket.

products.title: Bargi Jumpsuit - Blue Stripes
products.body_html:
• The Bargi Jumpsuit is one clean line from shoulder to hem, a blue monotone stripe translated into an easy, all-in-one silhouette.
  • Crafted in 100% yarn-dyed cotton with a blue monotone stripe, the fabric has a soft, breathable hand that drapes well over the body's length.
  • Pocket bags are cut in the shell fabric so the interiors carry the same stripe, with a braided top stitch quietly finishing the pocket mouth, a small craft mark on a functional detail.
  • A cross-stitch owl embroidery sits at the centre back, a cross-stitch flower at the front, and a butterfly motif on one leg, three small elements placed to surprise.
  • The silhouette is regular through the upper body and falls loosely from the hips into straight legs, the long vertical stripe naturally elongating the frame.
  • Easy for everyday and holiday alike, worn alone or layered under a simple white shirt.

products.title: Nova Kurta - Red Printed
products.body_html:
• The Nova Kaftan is holiday distilled, a loose red silhouette scattered with soft white bougainvillea, cut for slow mornings and long afternoons.
  • Crafted in 100% organic cotton voile, the fabric is airy and breathable, letting the digital botanical print float across the body.
  • White bougainvillea blossoms sit against a deep red base, a digital print that reads as soft and graphic at once, anchored in the flower's natural resilience.
  • A star embroidered in blue at the centre of a moon patch adds a small, unexpected celestial note against the floral print.
  • Pocket bags are cut in the shell fabric, a quiet functionality set inside an otherwise flowing piece.
  • A free-size loose cut and baby-hem finish make the kaftan effortless to throw on over swim or layer long for holiday evenings.

products.title: Aava Kurta - Blue & White Checks Embroidered
products.body_html:
• The Aava Kurta is a quiet garden of small motifs, heart and star-flower embroideries scattered across a fine blue-and-white check.
  • Crafted in 100% yarn-dyed cotton checks, the blue monotone weave has a clean, breathable hand with the structure of a considered shirt fabric.
  • Delicate all-over heart and star-flower embroideries run across the body, soft accents that lift the check into something more lyrical.
  • A denim twill tape with red kantha sits on the inner side of the slits on both sleeves, a hidden, tactile finishing that rewards a closer look.
  • A relaxed silhouette cut to sit easily across the body.
  • Suited to office and everyday wear, the kurta pairs effortlessly with tailored trousers or a straight-cut pant.

products.title: Vinya Kurta - Navy Blue & White Stripes
products.body_html:
• The Vinya Kurta brings the rhythm of a printed stripe into a clean, structured silhouette, a quiet meeting of tailoring and design.
  • Crafted in 100% cotton poplin, the fabric holds its shape with a crisp, considered hand that suits the kurta's straight cut.
  • Navy and white stripes are screen-printed onto the cloth, each press of the wooden block leaving small, intentional imperfections, a reminder of the hand behind the line.
  • A denim twill tape with red kantha runs inside the centre-front placket and along the sleeve hems, a small, tactile flash of colour hidden at the openings.
  • An applique owl in red sits at the inside sleeve bicep, a playful motif tucked quietly into the garment.
  • A straight silhouette meant for office and everyday, easy with tailored trousers or denim.

products.title: Kaari Kurta - Blue & Red Printed
products.body_html:
• The Kaari Kurta carries the spirit of the bougainvillea, bright, resilient, and at ease with itself, across a light, organic cotton voile.
  • Crafted in 100% organic cotton voile, the fabric is airy and breathable, letting the digital botanical print sit softly against the skin.
  • Red bougainvillea blossoms scatter across a deep blue base, a digital botanical print that turns the kurta into a quiet, colour-rich field.
  • An emerald-green kantha stitch runs along the shoulder line, away from the seam towards the front body, a small, hand-stitched line of contrast colour.
  • A tiny green star embroidery sits at the centre back, a quiet finishing signature.
  • The A-line cut and baby-hem finish make this kurta easy for everyday wera and small occasions alike, worn with Azara Pants or a simple straight-cut bottom.

products.title: Riha Kurta - White
products.body_html:
• The Riha Kurta is a considered white, an everyday A-line shaped around the quiet beauty of the selvedge.
  • Cut from 100% cotton yarn-dyed fabric with a blue selvedge on a clean white base, the cloth has a crisp, breathable hand that wears easily through the day.
  • A concealed placket keeps the front line clean, while cross-stitch motifs, owl, flower, and heart, sit scattered across the body, each hand-worked and slightly unique.
  • A baby-hem finishes the edges and the A-line silhouette gives the piece a soft, easy fall.
  • Kurta meant to layer easily over Azara Pants or slim denim.

products.title: Lazy Sunday Tunic - Red & Salmon Stripes
products.body_html:
• The Lazy Sunday Tunic is the cult favourite reimagined, this time in a hand-block-printed stripe, bringing the familiar silhouette a step closer to craft.
  • Crafted in 100% cotton voile with a fine construction, the fabric feels light and breathable against the skin, with just enough structure to hold the tunic's easy volume.
  • Monotone red stripes are hand-block-printed onto the cloth, each press of the wooden block carrying small, intentional irregularities, a reminder that these lines were made by hand.
  • A knife pleat at the centre-back neckline, attached to the collar, adds a soft sculptural detail at the back, movement built into the construction.
  • An electric-blue star embroidered just above the centre-back yoke seam sets a quiet, unexpected counterpoint to the warm red stripes.
  • A free-size loose cut, with a baby-hem finish make this an everyday pull-on, easy with Azara Pants or worn long on the slowest Sunday.

products.title: Lina Shirt with Slip - Blue & White Printed
products.body_html:
• The Lina Shirt draws on the resilience of the bougainvillea, a bloom that thrives in heat and stone, cut in a light, breathable cotton Kota.
  • Crafted in 100% cotton Kota, the fabric is sheer and light with a subtle open weave that lets the digital bougainvillea print breathe across a deep blue base.
  • White bougainvillea blossoms scatter softly across the cloth, a digital print that speaks to quiet resilience and beauty that endures.
  • A tonal blue leaver lace finishes the slip at the front and back neckline and hemline, a delicate, layered detail inside the transparency.
  • A red star embroidered just above the centre-back yoke seam adds a small, graphic anchor to the softness of the print.
  • A baby-hem finish keeps the edges light and feminine; the loose silhouette is made for evening and resort, worn over the slip so the layers move together.

products.title: Lona Necktie Top - Blue & White Checks
products.body_html:
• The Lona Necktie Top is a study in fine detail, tiny checks, finer pin-tucks, a neckline softened by a tie, a piece built from small, careful decisions.
  • Crafted in 100% yarn-dyed cotton checks, the very tiny blue-and-white weave reads as a quiet texture up close while holding its form with clean, crisp structure.
  • Very thin pin-tucks run across both the front and back yoke, and under the front yoke, a tailored gesture that lifts the top out of the everyday.
  • A cross-stitch heart border in red and sits just above the back hem, quietly placed near the side seam, an unexpected finishing note.
  • A silhouette cut for office and everyday wear, completed by a gentle neckline tie-up that tucks easily into Azara Pants or sits long over denim.

products.title: Hera Shirt - Blue & White Checks
products.body_html:
• The Hera Shirt takes the familiar architecture of a check shirt and adds a quiet layer of softness, a ruffle that runs from collar to cuff almost imperceptibly.
  • Crafted in 100% yarn-dyed cotton with a blue monotone check, the fabric has a crisp, considered hand that holds its structure while remaining breathable.
  • A fine ruffle runs from the collar through the placket out to the cuffs, a subtle femininity set against a traditionally tailored base.
  • Denim twill tape with red kantha lines the inside cuffs on the outer edge and red thread picks out the second placket button, cuff buttonholes, and their buttons, small signals of considered finishing.
  • A clean back pleat adds movement and ease across the shoulders, softening the structure of the shirt.
  • A fit at home in both office and elevated everyday wear, easy with tailored trousers or worn open over a tee.

products.title: Eira Top - Blue & White
products.body_html:
• The Eira Top is built around one quiet idea, the beauty of the selvedge, brought to the surface rather than hidden.
  • Cut from 100% cotton yarn-dyed fabric with a blue selvedge on a clean white base, the cloth has a crisp, considered hand that anchors the piece in everyday wear.
  • A scattered menagerie of cross-stitch motifs, heart, flower, bird, owl, polka, butterfly, and cactus, adds small, considered moments of craft across the body, each feeling slightly unique.
  • The selvedge is placed deliberately, running along the centre-front placket as a self-fold and along the hemlines of both back overlap panels, turning a construction detail into a design line.
  • A baby-hem finish keeps the edges clean, and the second button on the placket is stitched in red, a small, quiet accent among the cross-stitch.
  • Suited for both office and everyday, easy to layer under a jacket or wear open over a simple tee.

products.title: Zaya Top - Navy Blue & White Stripes
products.body_html:
• The Zaya Top carries the quiet confidence of a classic stripe and answers it with small, unexpected embroideries, the kind that reward a second look.
  • Woven in 100% cotton voile with a fine construction, screen-printed navy stripes run against a clean white base, giving the fabric a light, breathable hand that moves easily with the body.
  • Stripes are meticulously mitred across both sleeves, a small but telling mark of tailoring craft.
  • A red sequin star at the front, an icon heart embroidery just below the centre-back neckline, and a sequin bird tucked near the hem turn the top into a small story of hand-worked motifs.
  • At the hemline, a denim twill tape with red kantha runs through a drawstring tunnel, finished with heart-embroidered ends, adding a tactile and thoughtful close.
  • Suited for everyday wear and quieter evenings alike, easy with denim or tailored pants.

products.title: Savi Top - Red & Ivory Stripes
products.body_html:
• The Savi Top carries the story of Kala cotton, rain-fed, hand-spun, and handwoven in Kutch, into a loose, contemporary silhouette that softens beautifully with wear.
  • Red thread fagotting runs along the sleeve seam connecting to the neckline at both front and back, a hand-worked detail that draws attention to the joinery rather than hiding it.
  • A pixel heart embroidery in red and blue sits quietly on the back hem, just above the side seam, a small final note on an otherwise rhythmic stripe.
  • An ivory twill tape finishes the inside of the sleeve hem, and the top is marked with a special Kala cotton tag, a quiet reminder of where it began.
  • A free-size, loose silhouette with a single sleeve and yoke panel, made to layer over denim or pair with flowing bottoms for everyday, travel, or resort ease.

products.title: Tahi Top - Ivory & Red Embroidered
products.body_html:
• The Tahi Top is a gentle piece of joy, ivory softness scattered with colour, meant to lift the quietest outfits into something considered.
  • Crafted in 100% cotton kora, the fabric carries a natural, breathable handfeel with just enough body to hold the shape of a relaxed Blouson.
  • All-over cross-stitch embroidery in red runs across the ivory base, small rhythmic motifs that feel almost pixelated, a modern take on a traditional technique.
  • A red boondhi stitch forms the hemline drawstring tunnel, finished with an ivory-and-red kantha twill tape and a hand-beaded flower tassel, a small, tactile celebration at the close.
  • An everyday-to-holiday top, easily styled with Azara Pants for quiet workdays or flowing bottoms for slower, sunlit weekends.

products.title: Niva Shirt - White
products.body_html:
• The Niva Shirt is a quiet study in restraint, a foundational white that earns its place through craft rather than noise.
  • Crafted in 100% cotton poplin with a solid white paper finish, the fabric carries a crisp handfeel that holds its structure while softening gently with wear.
  • Fine French seams run throughout, a mark of considered construction, while a red-and-white striped twill tape sits along the outer edge of the inside cuff, adding a subtle flash of colour at the hem of the sleeve.
  • A small red star embroidered at the centre-back yoke, offers a quiet signature on an otherwise clean canvas.
  • The drop-shoulder silhouette is loose and easy, designed to drape rather than define.
  • An office-and-everyday shirt that pairs effortlessly with Azara Pants or Ella Culottes, equally at home tucked in or worn long.

products.title: Nadi Morning Set
products.body_html:
• Begin the day with quiet ritual in the Nadi Morning Set, complete with two Nadi Quarter Plates and two matching Nadi Straight Mugs.
  • Crafted in smooth stoneware, The Nadi quarter plates are dotted with motifs inspired by the lush landscape on the banks of river Teesta through Bengal.
  • With prints that are inspired by Teesta's path through Bengal, the Nadi Staright Mugs will prop up high tea with just the right infusion of colour and fun

products.title: Ele Palm Chip & Dip Platter
products.body_html:
• Our first-ever collection Ele has stood the test of time, a favourite at Nicobar. Its antique finish evokes the character of objects that have been loved for years, with natural variations that make each piece one of a kind.

• A set of two of our signature styles, the Basic Mid Length Kurta and the Basic Yellow Pyjamas in bright yellow.
  • An easy-wearing, relaxed kurta with slits along the sides for fuss-free movement. The yellow hue and relaxed cut makes it easy to pair with any outfit, adding a touch of effortless style to your look. Find our classic Nico star under the placket and a playful elephant at the back.
  • A style that's come to be our signature, this pyjama features an a-line silhouette that ends in a gentle flare. Crafted in lightweight material, it pairs perfectly with kurtas and shirts alike, and promises to be the hardest working piece in your closet.
  • Clean, light, and detailed up close, this set balances contrast and summer ease.

products.title: The Vaya Kaftan Set - Orange & White
products.body_html:
• The Vaya Kaftan Set brings together the Vaya Kaftan and Perch Pants in bold orange tones, designed for colour, ease, and movement.
  • The kaftan is crafted in big gingham checks with white thread chikankari embroidery framing the front neckline.
  • The pants feature a ditsy ice twig print on orange voile, finished with an ice blue heart embroidery placed at the bottom hem beside the side seam.
  • Together, the set balances graphic checks, airy print, and crafted accents in cotton, voile, and embroidery.

products.title: The Riva Top Set - Ivory
products.body_html:
• The Riva Top Set pairs the Riva Top with Breeze Pants in airy whites and ivories, designed for light summer dressing.
  • The top is crafted in organic cotton voile with chikankari moons, hearts, fish, and a bird motif, finished with mukaish dots throughout.
  • The pants bring texture through cotton kora, detailed with red boondi dots on the upper panel and a fish embroidery at the hem.
  • Together, the set blends delicate handwork, softness, and subtle river inspired motifs.

products.title: Orchard Sound Set
products.body_html:
• Chime into island time with the Orchard Sound Set, combining a breezy Pineapple Wind Chime and the melodic Anar Bell.
  • Bring the sound of Myanmar into your home with the gorgeous Pineapple Wind Chime, crafted in sturdy iron and finished in gold.
  • Crafted in iron with a matte gold finish, the Anar Bell hangs at the end of a looped rope and will sit perfectly at your main doorway

products.title: Everyday T-Shirt - Ice Blue
products.body_html:
• The Everyday T-Shirt in Ice Blue feels light yet expressive, like river air at dawn.
  • Crafted in smooth Supima cotton, it offers softness and breathability through the day.
  • At the chest, a stamp style leopard stretches among apricots, blending wildlife and orchard in a graphic that feels rooted in place.
  • Designed in a regular fit, it brings subtle narrative into relaxed dressing.

products.title: Everyday T-Shirt - Riverside Blue
products.body_html:
• The Everyday T-Shirt feels like a moment of pause along the journey.
  • Made in soft Supima cotton, it carries a lighter, smoother hand suited to warm days.
  • At the chest, a bulbul rests atop a crescent moon beneath a beach umbrella, blending whimsy with wanderlust, like a postcard from the river’s quieter stretches.
  • Cut in a regular fit, it balances character and comfort with effortless ease.

products.title: Postal T-Shirt - Beige
products.body_html:
• The Postal T-Shirt reads like a collection of places gathered into one.
  • Crafted in heavy cotton with a soft gold finish, it brings structure and presence to a relaxed silhouette.
  • The front carries a tiger stamp, while the back unfolds into a collage of palms, elephants, tigers, and the Nicobar heart, visual fragments that feel collected along Sindhu’s route.
  • Designed in a boxy fit, it turns everyday dressing into a canvas of memory and movement.

products.title: Leap T-Shirt - Brown
products.body_html:
• The Leap T-Shirt captures the quiet strength of the wild.
  • Made in heavy cotton with a soft gold finish, it offers weight and grounding.
  • Across the back, a leopard moves against a mountain horizon with a heart strung at its neck, a symbol of instinct carried with tenderness, while a paw motif rests at the chest.
  • Cut in a boxy silhouette, it brings landscape and story into everyday wear.

products.title: Bulbul T-Shirt - Ivory
products.body_html:
• The Bulbul T-Shirt carries the spirit of travel, where stories are stamped and sent across distances.
  • Crafted in heavy cotton with a soft gold finish, it feels grounded and substantial against the skin.
  • At the chest, a stamp inspired graphic frames a bulbul perched in a tree, like a memory gathered along the river’s path, finished with a subtle red sleeve accent.
  • Designed in a boxy fit, it brings narrative and ease together in a piece made for everyday movement.

products.title: Aurora Dress with Slip - Turmeric Yellow

products.title: Scoop Back Dress - Mint & Watermelon Print
products.body_html:
• The Scoop Back Dress makes its entrance softly—bold in print, fluid in form.
  • Set against a mint base and made in Bemberg, the watermelon rose chintz adds colour and contrast, while the open back and smocking offer ease without losing shape.
  • Striped fabric trims the tie-ups and hem, adding a playful touch to the silhouette, while layered flower tassels at the tie ends and no centre seams keep the flow uninterrupted.
  • Crafted from cotton linter, a natural byproduct of cottonseed oil production, Bemberg is a regenerated cellulose fibre that’s soft, breathable, and gentle on the skin. It’s biodegradable, compostable, and made using a closed-loop process that minimises waste, making it a thoughtful choice for you and the planet.

products.body_html:

  • Comes with a craft tag.

products.title: This Is Leonardo Da Vinci
products.body_html: • This book traces Leonardo's career and private world, both of which were vibrant and active, and what establishes him as the definition of the Renaissance Man.

products.title: This Is Pollock
products.body_html:
• This book traces Pollock's career and discusses how his loose, individual style was used as a political weapon in the Cold War, representing America as the free, democratic nation
  • Illustrations simplify the theory and reveal the hidden meaning behind the mesh of painted lines.

products.title: Seize the Day: A Dateless Planner (Diary)
products.body_html:
• Start this diary whenever you want, not just in January
  • From Chinese New Year to Thanksgiving, the illustrations by Sophia Augusta will guide you through the year
  • Includes useful information such as flight durations, alternative calendar systems, astrological charts and even helpful words in other languages
  • Plus a 32-page booklet outlined in a neat windowpane grid for your notes.

products.title: The Boy Who Bit Picasso
products.body_html:
• This book tells the true story of Antony Penrose, son of the photographer Lee Miller and the painter and writer Roland Penrose
  • Anthony shares here his childhood memories of his remarkable playmate, a world-famous artist by the name of Pablo Picasso
  • The book features over 65 glorious illustrations, including many artworks by Picasso, photographs by Lee Miller, and specially comissioned drawings by children.

products.title: Paul Gauguin: Ramblings of a Wannabe Painter
products.body_html:
• Once a plein-air painter, Paul Gauguin's last essay Racontars de Rapin, in its English translation by French writer Donatien Grau, talks about the Post-Impressionist painter's views on the critiquing of his own art and as a larger theme running across the works of his contemporaries
  • With the express hope of encouraging open exchange between the world of writing and that of the visual arts, Ramblings of a Wannabe Painter is a closer look at Gauguin's views on the same.

products.title: Read This if You Want to Be Instagram Famous
products.body_html:
• All said and done, there's a formula (that can always be tweaked or tinkered with) to becoming Instagram famous
  • This handy little manual is packed with glossy images clicked by Instagrammers around the world, interjected with interviews, quotes, tips, techniques, kit ideas, and more
  • Needless to say, this one's perfect for when you're travelling, and its compact size means it'll slip into any tote or backpack with ease.

products.title: Roy Lichtenstein's ABC
products.body_html:
• Roy Lichtenstein's distinctive look is one of the most identifiable in all contemporary art
  • This book celebrates his unique style with the ABC, with results that are surprising, delightful, and amusing
  • This mini-retrospective is a must for art-lovers, letter-lovers, and those just cutting their teeth on the alphabet.

products.title: Enchanted Forest: An Inky Quest & Colouring Book
products.body_html:
• Johanna Basford takes readers on an inky quest through an Enchanted Forest to discover what lies in the castle at its heart, with her new colouring book
  • Drawings to colour and embellish aside, there are hidden animals and magical objects to be found along the way, including nine special symbols
  • Find all the symbols to unlock the castle door and reveal what lies within!.

products.title: How to Thrive in the Next Economy
products.body_html: • Is there no escape from an economy that devours nature in the name of endless growth? John Thackara's answer is a rousing 'yes, there is!' Drawing on a lifetime of travel in search of real-world alternatives that work, he describes in this book how communities the world over are creating a replacement economy from the ground up.

products.title: Mary Poppins Up, Up and Away
products.body_html:
• This dreamy book is a beautifully crafted homage to P
  • L
  • Traver' much-loved stories, with page after page of intricate lasercuts and enchanted drawings
  • In this one Mary Poppins, Michael, and Jane step out to see some of London's great sights.

products.title: Nicholas in Trouble
products.body_html:
• This is a classic children's fiction to be read, re-read, and cherished forever
  • Created by Rene Goscinny, the author of Asterix, and world-renowned illustrator Jean-Jacques Sempe, the Nicholas books have charmed millions around the world
  • We love books that make children laugh out loud, and this one promises to be a raving delight.

products.title: Where Chefs Eat: A Guide to Chefs' Fav Rest
products.body_html: • Over 400 of the world's leading chefs list their favourite places to eat, from neighbourhood eateries to highend restaurants, and this comprehensive directory is all you need when you're planning travels to new cities and need recommendations you can bank on.

products.title: Asian Lives: A Closer Look
products.body_html:
• In 2011, adhering to his mentor Henri Cartier-Bresson's mantra to 'photograph the truth', animation filmmaker Ishu Patel's book embarks on a journey essaying South East Asia
  • Never political or judgemental, the collection comprises Patel's homage to the everyday lives of Asians.
